programme.desc: 九名藝員分別起程，前赴中國內地、日本、台灣體驗另類生活，分享自己的故事及旅程得着。余德丞先為觀眾聲音導航，揭開十集節目的序幕。黎諾懿自小嚮往尋找一個適合長居的世外桃園，跟另一半歸隱田園過簡單生活。諾懿深入雲南大理某個村落，探訪一位寧願放棄米芝蓮廚師職位的隱居法籍大廚。愛煮食的諾懿一到埗便參觀廚房，發覺簡單的生活都可以有要求！他隨後與大廚一同買菜以及走進農場捉雞，卻「投訴」毫無難度！

programme.title: 世界養生組織[粵]
programme.desc: 今時今日問10個人有什麼願望，9個人會答:身體健康！這些日子，疫症肆虐，人人都要增強抵抗力，才能與病毒共存；拉闊點看，人類平均壽命延長了，不好好保養自己等老了體弱多病的話，苦了自己也苦了家人，怎過意得去！

programme.title: 手匠傳承[粵/韓]
programme.desc: 吳哥金屬工藝是柬埔寨特別的藝術品，本集將會講述製作過程及其背後意義。印度教神話故事對柬埔寨藝術的影響十分深遠, 工匠把故事刻在工藝品上, 希望可以讓故事繼續流傳, 並延續祖先文化的傳統.

programme.title: 文明啟航[粵/英]
programme.desc: 歷史學家Bettany Hughes 再次踏上旅程，探索更多人類歷史上最引人入勝的故事，揭開世界各地鮮為人知的歷史和非凡文物。

programme.title: 細味文明[粵/英]
programme.desc: 遨遊全世界最受歡迎且充滿美態與魅力的旅遊勝地，欣賞美妙的天然奇景、引人入勝的古蹟、精湛的手工藝和迷人的景色。帶觀眾踏上難忘的旅程，融入夢想旅遊目的地的傳統與歷史裡。

programme.title: 香港遊樂團[粵]
programme.desc: 滕麗名、吳家樂、江欣燕、胡諾言、梁嘉琪、陳浚霆到訪石鼓洲康復院，男院友平日負責修葺設施，而由院友一手一腳建成的羅馬式儲水池，令眾主持嘆為觀止。六人難得來到，當然不只是遊覽。他們分成兩隊做義工，一組展開「髹牆」旅程，另一組則修剪草坪，埋頭苦幹了一個早上。辛苦事陸續有來，眾人最後還要修建道路，要知道擔泥舖地絕非小兒科粗活，他們雖然做到汗流浹背，但大功告成的一刻卻有種難以形容的滿足。

programme.title: 香港遊樂團[粵]
programme.desc: 吳家樂、滕麗名、胡諾言、江欣燕、梁嘉琪、陳浚霆繼續在石鼓洲康復院服務，先嘗試廢物利用「揼鞋架」，事後竟強迫木工導師稱讚每份傑作！眾人又自告奮勇清潔獨立「羊」房、露天龜池，一邊做一邊胡鬧，在勞碌的探訪中尋找樂趣。石鼓洲風光宜人，欣欣與阿滕趁美景當前，展露巧手廚藝鼓勵院友；禮尚往來，院方義工亦炮製了「石鼓洲炒飯」分甘同味。回到市區，家樂邀請張智軒、喬寶寶與立志遠離毒品的年青人比賽足球，戰況如何？

programme.title: Do姐有問題[粵]
programme.desc: 多位「好戲之人」同來接受Do姐考驗，田蕊妮與李思捷組隊，迎戰黎耀祥和胡定欣。泰國夜市海鮮檔為食客提供「三寶」，當中的冰桶有甚麼作用？阿田答對題目，為何卻咀咒自己會扣分？台北貓舍收容了不少貓貓，負責人想出「屎橋」，能讓貓咪們「自給自足」！東京老字號專賣店主打一種竹製品，到底是甚麼？雨傘專門店有售超過一萬把雨傘，其中一款設計獨特的「縮骨遮」更可用作保護某物件。今集兌換獎金創出新高，哪一隊是幸運兒？

programme.title: 十築台灣[粵/普]
programme.desc: 隨韻潔到台中一間由舊樓改建的旅宿，牆身的鋼筋、水泥突顯出原始、粗獷感，而天井配合燈光有何效果？露台除可增加採光度，當中的植物亦為舊建築帶來生命力。台11線兼具山海靚景，當地一間被藤蔓覆蓋的旅宿，原始簡樸；另一間以灰、黑為主調的旅宿，荒廢感在蔚藍海岸及翠綠植物旁尤為突出，不妨在此享受寧靜、悠閒。一間為單人打造的旅宿，為甚麼會以三角形打造空間？房間陳設都是向外擺放，讓客人享受獨處時光，同時享受大自然。

programme.title: 十築台灣[粵/普]
programme.desc: 台灣近年越趨重視宗教建築設計，除了知名建築師姚仁喜設計的農禪寺，由德國得獎設計師打造的菁寮聖十字架天主堂亦富有特色。四個鋁建的金字塔形屋頂各有雕像，而教堂內有何融入台灣文化的設計？台灣護聖宮以玻璃圍繞，可謂突破傳統廟宇的形像，亦結合科技，令建築能抵抗強風與地震。位於宜蘭的長老教會，建築師特意將主堂撐起，亦讓天然光線透進內部建築，主堂的木質蛋形結構有何意思？建築師又講解教堂設計與聖經故事的連繫。

programme.title: 星夢頻道[粵/日]
programme.desc: 吉祥物Bug Bug CHU身體不適，讓老氣妹壞壞相當擔心，更找上小光商量。就在這時，神秘人物在她們面前出現，並說只有做演唱會才能治好Bug Bug CHU，但老氣妹壞壞並不擅長唱歌跳舞，情急之下又向小光求助……

programme.title: 喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2[粵/普]
喜羊羊與灰太狼之羊羊趣冒險2[粵/普]
多啦A夢[粵]
programme.desc: 一群小孩聚集在空地，大家都找到趣味相投的人一起玩以及交流，但唯獨喜歡花繩的大雄孤獨一人。胖虎聽完叔叔的一番說話之後，決定不再欺負人，並且對弱者加以保護。大雄被選中為受保護的對象。

programme.title: 古典樂之星[粵/日]
programme.desc: 貝多芬考試不及格，再此下去會有退學之虞。蕭邦願意為貝多芬補習，但交換條件是貝多芬成為蕭邦隨從，貝多芬惟有陪他採訪、購物，被他連番折騰。但接下來蕭邦在舞台上的表現，卻震撼了不忘重返拳擊的貝多芬。

programme.title: 盲盒鐵路遊[粵]
programme.desc: 衍峰、秀怡、嘉慧在重慶未玩夠，繼續遊走。先「貼地」搭民生鐵路，路軌卻離地甚高，絕對「不貼地」，鐵路還會「穿越」大廈，而要影到「吞鐵」打卡相原來不易！食方面亦繼續貼地，坐上矮櫈，將辣麵放在高櫈上進食，品嚐其「麻辣鮮香」的特色！再試由幾種家鄉風味隨意混搭出的草根美味，一嚐江湖菜滋味。突發盲盒任務，三人被蒙眼帶往某景點，打開眼罩已置身高空玻璃平台，節目組還安排升級任務，要主持們在懸空步道走一圈！

programme.title: 香港美食匠人[粵]
programme.desc: 經歷高低起跌，名廚黃永幟對烹飪仍保持一份堅持與執着。幟哥親力親為到海鮮市場揀貨，芷珊前往取經，再一嚐惹火龍蝦菜。XO醬如何由名貴小食變特色調味料？這位「XO醬兼楊枝甘露之父」談及味道平衡的重要。人生下半場決心轉行，匠人蘇炎文將裁縫精神注入流心燉蛋，更闖出名堂。除了揀蛋、奶有要求，燉煮時間都超精準！蝦子麵要將麵粉與高湯完美調和，麵廠主理人陳漢傑承繼父業後體會到父親之苦。老字號引入改革，面對甚麼挑戰？

programme.title: 香港美食匠人[粵]
programme.desc: 本地掀起多時的新派酥皮蛋撻熱潮，與一位在港落地生根的瑞士烘焙大師息息相關。大師焗製的酸種蛋撻據悉每日吸引長龍，為免顧客撲空失望，他更不辭勞苦加班製作。他亦熱愛香港美食，還嘗試將叉燒等融入包餅中。清晨開爐熬製的香綿粥底，加上以銅煲滾煮，一碗美味的鮮魚粥才告誕生。據指有外地人念念不忘專程再來吃粥，支持主理人的烹調用心。潮州菜館師傅醉心鑽研滷水，勇敢跳出傳統框架，採用嶄新材料搭配，芷珊大讚出品層次豐富。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季[粵/普]
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: 澳洲潮什麼[粵]
programme.desc: 來到陽光海岸，動靜皆宜，漫步六十公里長灘好Chill；乘坐前水警艇在海上高速起伏、轉彎，則刺激十足！到農場擠駱駝奶先要取得其信任？駱駝也「黏人」，還主動向芷珮「送抱」。再結識另一動物朋友，騎馬踏步海灘，迎接閃閃浪花。遊船河感受原住民風情，兼享美酒佳餚，深入了解當地文化。行逛人氣市集後，芷珮勇闖叢林挑戰高空飛索、繩網障礙，考驗身手與膽量。大沼澤地生態也值得遊人探索，坐船穿梭河道濕地，見識大自然奧妙。

programme.title: 甜心先生[粵]
programme.desc: 港姐季軍郭嘉文勤奮好學，自當選以來工作機會不斷。她在節目中接受另一挑戰，與阿古(古嘉俊)合力製作一款「茉莉熱情果薑味牛奶朱古力馬卡龍」，融合二人創意炮製出精彩滋味。期間阿古竟要她將牛油紙視為「仇人」？

programme.title: 星光魔法[粵/日]
programme.desc: 希娜要為雜誌拍照，祭跟著去學習，同場的還有米露琪。另一名模特兒因病缺席，攝影師相中祭，讓她臨時頂替，米露琪不是味兒，故意教祭錯誤知識。最後工作人員提議拍攝星光魔法，米露琪竟然推卻。

programme.title: Hands Up[粵]
programme.desc: 兒童節目《Hands Up》有「醬汁家族」成員和一眾主持，陪伴大家度過愉快時光。「Kids’ Notes」邀請不同界別人士，跟小朋友分享有趣事物；透過「勇闖小兵團」遊戲，讓孩子們快樂遊玩；運動教練引領大家「Workout 2gether」，鍛練身體；還會透過「Artspiration」，引領孩子了解藝術世界；「My Little Show」開放表演舞台，小朋友到來盡情展示才藝！

programme.title: 屁屁偵探[粵/日]
programme.desc: 改編自人氣繪本。各位小朋友快跟著無人不知的名偵探屁屁偵探全面出擊，透過細心觀察及推理，偵破各類案件吧！

programme.title: 櫻桃小丸子[粵/日]
programme.desc: 小丸子被推舉成為組長，負責統籌話劇排練，起初因受稱讚而得意，後因貪玩取消練習惹眾人不滿，終承認錯誤。小丸子陪爺爺搭巴士去做針灸，覺得按下車鈴充滿樂趣，後來卻發現有一男孩搶著按鈴。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲[粵]
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 財經透視[粵]
programme.desc: 《財經透視》緊貼大市，回顧每周港股走勢外，並關注樓市狀況，透過業界人士專訪、市場分析等，深入淺出探討本港、國際財經金融熱門話題，更以專題形式報道不同行業發展面對的問題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道[粵]
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告[粵]
邵逸夫獎2026[粵]
programme.desc: 2026年度邵逸夫生命科學與醫學獎，平均頒予安妮‧德尚、戴宇閣及陳竺，以表彰他們發現急性早幼粒細胞白血病在分子與細胞層面的致病基礎，並開創了協同標靶治療方案，令這種疾病從最致命的癌症行列，轉變為治癒率最高的癌症之一，治癒率超過九成。2026年度邵逸夫天文學獎平均頒予野本憲一，以及斯坦福‧伍斯利，以表彰他們對恆星爆炸和元素起源的研究。而數學科學獎則由伊曼紐爾‧康德斯和卡米洛‧德‧雷列斯獲得，以表彰他們在運用深刻數學分析技術，解決重要應用方面取得的突破性貢獻。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 IV[粵]
programme.desc: 《警聲百二秒 IV》引領觀眾「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭過去未來」，並繼續以輕鬆有趣的系列表達方式，讓市民接收豐富的警隊資訊，說好香港警察故事。

programme.title: 東張西望[粵]
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 中信銀行(國際)Motion$呈獻：試真D唷[粵]
programme.desc: 江美儀再度領軍，攜手張振朗、朱敏瀚、吳業坤、曾展望組成「試真D團隊」，在首季熱播及網民的熱烈推崇下載譽歸來。這趟全新的台灣深度探索之旅，各人將繼續以輕鬆真實、貼地玩樂的風格，引領觀眾深入寶島腹地。團隊前赴高雄、台南與台北，延續節目精神，發掘在網路上評價兩極的爭議店舖，以及隱藏於城市角落、鮮為人知的小眾新奇體驗。眾人堅持呈現最真實的現場反饋，旨在為觀眾打造一本不踩坑的實用遊台指南。

programme.title: Funki Finance 呈獻：女神配對計劃2[粵]
programme.desc: 戀愛真人騷《女神配對計劃》火熱回歸，第二季戀愛戰場全面升級！「金牌媒人」Bob林盛斌招募全球男士，為女神何沛珈、郭珮文、陳若思、俞可程、阮嘉敏開展戀愛配對。求愛勇者接受心動撳燈、五角枱約會等挑戰，各出奇謀冧女神。一對一親密遊戲引爆心跳警報，還有隱藏女神加入戰團，火花進一步升溫……更多求愛考驗來臨，勇者們力求走到最後，攻陷女神心！此外，上季五位女神與星級嘉賓們輪流成為「花生團」，直擊女神約會實況。

programme.title: 及時雨信貸呈獻：一周星星[粵]
programme.desc: 訪談節目《一周星星》，每集邀請星級藝人、界別名人，與區永權、許文軒、王鎮泉等娛樂主播，分享新近工作企劃，談論電影、電視、演唱會相關的特別話題，尤其是網民與圈中朋友關心熱議的人和事！周邊訊息如此多，節目特設「Fact Check」核實環節，由嘉賓親自回應各式各樣的傳聞，讓當事人說清楚箇中真相！

programme.title: 伯樂音樂學院20週年呈獻：J Music[粵]
programme.desc: 《J Music》致力打造高質音樂平台，一眾歌手有展示音樂實力的機會之餘，也可讓樂迷更深入了解歌手的音樂故事。節目邀請「人氣」歌手擔任嘉賓，由嘉賓親自挑選其喜歡的新舊作品，並即場演唱，分享喜愛曲目。而一些樂壇新面孔亦會亮相，透過互動交流，展現音樂潛力。此外，每集緊貼「勁歌金榜」最新形勢，還會帶來不同歌手、創作人或製作人的訪問，跟觀眾暢談作品，以至音樂業界的人和事。

programme.title: 美食新聞周報[粵]
programme.desc: 黃嘉雯、蔡景行、施焯日等主持親往熱搜餐廳試味，推介自駕覓食好去處，發掘各區「掃街」名物、名人愛店，驗證網上「抵食」傳聞；又會相約居港的外國人，到訪經他們認證的家鄉風味食肆。名廚、食評家、美食KOL、各區地膽及的士司機亦會帶路「搵食」，帶來專業推介；識食之人還會細說美食典故。節目精選《美食新聞報道》介紹的多間「人氣」餐廳，力推當中招牌美食，並會速遞美食優惠，讓觀眾即時掌握最滋味、抵食的飲食情報。

programme.title: 晚間新聞[粵]
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告[粵]
飛虎3壯志英雄#20[粵][PG]
programme.desc: 高子樂發現杜以盈乘坐的車上有血跡，覺得可疑，卻在許森的舉報下，拿不到行車記錄儀的紀錄；嘉軒回憶起與許森一起長大的故事，許的神祕面紗慢慢揭開；Mike發現有人跟蹤他，跟蹤者還很快被滅口，一切矛頭指向Mike。

programme.title: 東張西望[粵]
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 初入職場·中醫季[粵/普]
programme.desc: 《初入職場·中醫季》深度聚焦中醫文化，攜手中醫專業人才及中醫助力團一起，通過"潮養生活"與"中醫歷練"，開啟一場年輕態的中醫文化科普之旅。

programme.title: 澳洲潮什麼[粵]
programme.desc: 來到陽光海岸，動靜皆宜，漫步六十公里長灘好Chill；乘坐前水警艇在海上高速起伏、轉彎，則刺激十足！到農場擠駱駝奶先要取得其信任？駱駝也「黏人」，還主動向芷珮「送抱」。再結識另一動物朋友，騎馬踏步海灘，迎接閃閃浪花。遊船河感受原住民風情，兼享美酒佳餚，深入了解當地文化。行逛人氣市集後，芷珮勇闖叢林挑戰高空飛索、繩網障礙，考驗身手與膽量。大沼澤地生態也值得遊人探索，坐船穿梭河道濕地，見識大自然奧妙。

programme.title: 甜心先生[粵]
programme.desc: 港姐季軍郭嘉文勤奮好學，自當選以來工作機會不斷。她在節目中接受另一挑戰，與阿古(古嘉俊)合力製作一款「茉莉熱情果薑味牛奶朱古力馬卡龍」，融合二人創意炮製出精彩滋味。期間阿古竟要她將牛油紙視為「仇人」？

programme.title: 盲盒鐵路遊[粵]
programme.desc: 衍峰、秀怡、嘉慧在重慶未玩夠，繼續遊走。先「貼地」搭民生鐵路，路軌卻離地甚高，絕對「不貼地」，鐵路還會「穿越」大廈，而要影到「吞鐵」打卡相原來不易！食方面亦繼續貼地，坐上矮櫈，將辣麵放在高櫈上進食，品嚐其「麻辣鮮香」的特色！再試由幾種家鄉風味隨意混搭出的草根美味，一嚐江湖菜滋味。突發盲盒任務，三人被蒙眼帶往某景點，打開眼罩已置身高空玻璃平台，節目組還安排升級任務，要主持們在懸空步道走一圈！

programme.title: 香港美食匠人[粵]
programme.desc: 經歷高低起跌，名廚黃永幟對烹飪仍保持一份堅持與執着。幟哥親力親為到海鮮市場揀貨，芷珊前往取經，再一嚐惹火龍蝦菜。XO醬如何由名貴小食變特色調味料？這位「XO醬兼楊枝甘露之父」談及味道平衡的重要。人生下半場決心轉行，匠人蘇炎文將裁縫精神注入流心燉蛋，更闖出名堂。除了揀蛋、奶有要求，燉煮時間都超精準！蝦子麵要將麵粉與高湯完美調和，麵廠主理人陳漢傑承繼父業後體會到父親之苦。老字號引入改革，面對甚麼挑戰？

programme.title: 香港美食匠人[粵]
programme.desc: 本地掀起多時的新派酥皮蛋撻熱潮，與一位在港落地生根的瑞士烘焙大師息息相關。大師焗製的酸種蛋撻據悉每日吸引長龍，為免顧客撲空失望，他更不辭勞苦加班製作。他亦熱愛香港美食，還嘗試將叉燒等融入包餅中。清晨開爐熬製的香綿粥底，加上以銅煲滾煮，一碗美味的鮮魚粥才告誕生。據指有外地人念念不忘專程再來吃粥，支持主理人的烹調用心。潮州菜館師傅醉心鑽研滷水，勇敢跳出傳統框架，採用嶄新材料搭配，芷珊大讚出品層次豐富。

programme.title: 十築台灣[粵/普]
programme.desc: 隨韻潔到台中一間由舊樓改建的旅宿，牆身的鋼筋、水泥突顯出原始、粗獷感，而天井配合燈光有何效果？露台除可增加採光度，當中的植物亦為舊建築帶來生命力。台11線兼具山海靚景，當地一間被藤蔓覆蓋的旅宿，原始簡樸；另一間以灰、黑為主調的旅宿，荒廢感在蔚藍海岸及翠綠植物旁尤為突出，不妨在此享受寧靜、悠閒。一間為單人打造的旅宿，為甚麼會以三角形打造空間？房間陳設都是向外擺放，讓客人享受獨處時光，同時享受大自然。

programme.title: 十築台灣[粵/普]
programme.desc: 台灣近年越趨重視宗教建築設計，除了知名建築師姚仁喜設計的農禪寺，由德國得獎設計師打造的菁寮聖十字架天主堂亦富有特色。四個鋁建的金字塔形屋頂各有雕像，而教堂內有何融入台灣文化的設計？台灣護聖宮以玻璃圍繞，可謂突破傳統廟宇的形像，亦結合科技，令建築能抵抗強風與地震。位於宜蘭的長老教會，建築師特意將主堂撐起，亦讓天然光線透進內部建築，主堂的木質蛋形結構有何意思？建築師又講解教堂設計與聖經故事的連繫。

Now Forum E1023 -嘉賓：黃偉綸 (財政司副司長兼署理房屋局局長 / 題目：跟進宏福苑火災 / 大鳴大放 第1023集 - 嘉賓：黃偉綸 (財政司副司長兼署理房屋局局長 / 題目：跟進宏福苑火災
programme.desc: 11月成立的公營房屋樓宇管制組，房屋局獨立審查組300人會原班過渡。兼任署理房屋局局長的財政司副司長黃偉綸接受《大鳴大放》專訪時指出，做法「不只是改名」，人員會加強培訓，不同意「換湯不換藥」的講法。黃偉綸表示ICU的300人調入管制組，不同意有記者指稱換湯不換藥：「不只是改名，目前叫ICU（架構)它不會再存在。在過往一段時間都做了超過10個培訓班或培訓會，大家的警覺性和意識都提高。我們知道其中一個問題是處理文化改變。」他指工作模式的轉變是會帶來工作文化上的改變，管制組的工作模式與ICU有重大的變化，未來以大型維修項目為基礎。現在的ICU的工作是以專業功能為基礎，有時候看工地，或有些組別是看小型工程，不好處是從業主立案法團或居民角度而言，不知可聯絡誰。獨立委員會批評轉介機制以往做得不好，黃偉綸說現在加強了：「我們有一個項目專隊看著整個項目，他知道整個項目發生的事情，可全面掌控所有資訊，加強了管制組的不同部門的溝通。」他舉例ICU以往與屋宇署一年開一次會，現改為至少一季開一次會。另外，每個項目有聯絡專員：「我覺得這個一站式，也是全方位的服務，對法團來說，比起目前都是一個很重大的改變。我們相信以項目為基礎這個做法，也都推動到文化的改變，變成了每個項目有個直接對口。」他續指管制組的實地巡查次數大幅增加，如果是個別工程項目最少四個月會有一個實地的巡查，若有需要，會加密巡查次數。

programme.desc: 宏福苑火災獨立委員會報告公布，讚揚消防英勇救火，但同時也批評其多次巡查也沒有發現問題，監察不足。保安局局長鄧炳強在接受本台節目《大鳴大放》訪問時承認，有關情況當時確實有改善空間，但現在已改善了。鄧炳強說：「委員會講出了一些我們沒有做的事情，都是事實來的......消防同事都是有承擔的，事發之後我們確實做了很多工作，令到日後的安全有所改善。」此外，鄧炳強又談及萬聖節周末的口岸交通安排，因應皇崗口岸上周末深夜大塞車，大批旅客參加萬聖月活動和演唱會等盛事後要排長龍離境，保安局得悉情況後立刻與深圳市有關部門商討延長深圳灣口岸開放時間，最終達成共識，延長周五和周六關口時間至凌晨二時，並會優先放行小巴、巴士等前往皇崗口岸。被問到會否將延長關口的措施恆常化，鄧炳強重申要視乎情況：「其實有做，例如現時的跨年倒數，深圳灣口岸開通宵，另外羅湖東鐵都會多開兩小時，至於其他日子我們都要觀察......若是私家車過關 ，我覺得在大時大節，若能在其他關口，例如深圳灣可以延長(通關)，這一定有所幫助。」他呼籲旅客盡量使用跨境巴士和公共交通工具，而各部門也已加派人手在關口應對。

programme.title: now Report E529 -遊艇經濟 / 經緯線 第529集 - 遊艇經濟
programme.desc: 行政長官李家超於去年《施政報告》宣布推動遊艇經濟，指出香港擁有長達1180公里的海岸線及263個島嶼，具備成為亞洲遊艇樞紐的優勢。今年相關政策陸續落實，繼六月「港艇北上」開通後，政府推出便利境外遊艇入境措施，「粵艇南下」亦於上月中首航。首批南下的粵艇共有五艘，分別來自深圳、珠海及廣州南沙。署理財政司司長黃偉綸在歡迎儀式上表示，「港艇北上」與「粵艇南下」對兩地居民、旅客及經濟發展皆為互利共贏。參與首航的深圳鴻洲國際遊艇會總經理葉潤年認為，香港作為自由港對遊艇旅客極具吸引力。他實測開遊艇至中環公眾碼頭上岸觀光，但公眾碼頭非專為遊艇設計，乘客下船略顯不便，他建議政府參考內地做法，興建公共遊艇碼頭，提升便利與安全。公眾碼頭只供即上即落，遊艇要停泊可選擇政府指定免費錨泊區，包括赤柱灣、淺水灣、西貢企嶺下海等；同樣有參與首航的珠海市遊艇協會會長廖凱指出，錨泊區位置偏遠，且缺乏登岸設施及水電補給，他寧願付費使用私人遊艇會設施。香港船多泊位少，全港逾1.2萬艘遊樂船，僅有4000多個合規格泊位，私人泊位一位難求；政府表示將會發展四個新遊艇會，預計增加約1100個泊位。香港遊艇協進會會長何偉樂表示新遊艇會發展需時，恐追不上鄰近地區步伐，建議政府善用使用率低的中港城碼頭，增設遊艇設施。要成為亞洲遊艇樞紐，香港除了解決泊位不足，還有哪些地方，例如人才與配套等方面需要提升？

programme.desc: 說起設計，大眾的印象不外乎都是那幾樣：女生們的童年夢想——時裝設計師？抑或是男生們的「另一半」——汽車設計師。然而更多的，可能是來自父母的反對：不穩定？不實際？在我們創作力最旺盛的時候，這團烈火往往輕易就被澆熄。事實上，我們生活的每一處都充斥著設計的身影。你每天早上苦惱的髮型，你途中走過的建築，甚至是路過的一草一木，背後都是設計師精心設計過後呈現的藝術品。設計，絕非遙不可及。本節目將搜尋並拜訪香港本土各行設計師，了解這個行業的日常工作，發掘這方面的就業前景，讓對設計有興趣的年輕人知道更多這個行業的事，了解設計到底是怎麼一回事，在欣賞各種設計的同時，也希望呈現和宣揚本地設計師的創意，堅定每一位有設計夢的觀眾，讓創作的心燃燒下去。

programme.title: Talker - One Beside You 3 E463 -高靈人士Jackie分享靈異個案 / 晚吹 - 總有一瓣喺左近 第463集 - 高靈人士Jackie分享靈異個案
programme.desc: 早前有一位內地網紅車禍離世，據說她生前就曾多次拍片以破除迷信作為理由挑戰靈界、包括招靈砸觀音像、詛咒自己等，引發網民熱論。今集嘉賓高靈人士Jackie分享的個案，事主就因為禍從口出胡亂評論逝者外貌，最後惹上麻煩。

programme.title: 3 mins Enews E1489 / 3 分鐘熱度 第1489集
programme.desc: 娛樂資訊節目《3分鐘熱度》是ViuTV一個自家製作，集娛樂圈消息及熱話的精華式娛樂資訊節目，以明快節奏、幽默角度報道本港及海外演藝界最新動態，快而準追蹤娛樂圈消息。

programme.title: Before The End E8 -江湖 / 存酒人 第8集 - 江湖
programme.desc: 總有些酒客叫人特別記得，車房老闆「啞仔」是其中一個，關於他的傳聞很多，鬼妹聽過他跟江湖女子Vic的故事。一切從Vic被江湖大佬東哥追殺開始，那天她躲進了陌生人啞仔的車房，啞仔可憐她的遭遇，因此收留她幾天。三日時間，同情發展成愛情，二人關係發展得風馳電掣，卻刻骨銘心，讓人記得一輩子。

programme.title: Haunted Road Trip II E1 -南威爾斯 - 兒童醫院 (I) / 撞鬼自駕遊 II 第1集 - 南威爾斯 - 兒童醫院 (I)
programme.desc: <撞鬼自駕遊>載譽歸來，ViuTV小鬼王193搵嚟新拍檔米露迪，再次勇闖歐洲自駕遊撞鬼！第一站就到南威爾斯有近二百年歷史嘅Craig Y Nos Castle。佢曾經用作兒童醫院，有唔少小朋友喺度過身。兩位主持喺荒廢幾十年嘅醫院範圍靈探，鬼影幢幢。會唔會有小朋友靈體出現？

programme.title: My Perfect Stranger E4 / 偶然遇見的你 第4集
programme.desc: 但因為警察突然到來盤問允英的身份，海俊只好為她轉學到他任教的學校。允英也在學校中得知更多順愛的過去。

programme.title: The Prisoner of Beauty E11 / 折腰 第11集
programme.desc: 小喬去首飾舖找工匠製作手鐲，工匠失手雕壞了花樣，恰好來這裡的魏儼出了主意，才這件壽禮沒有留下遺憾。小喬本十分感謝魏儼的幫忙，但見他舉止輕浮，內心不悅。

programme.title: Unhumble Cooking E8 -松葉蟹 / 嘥料 第8集 - 松葉蟹
programme.desc: 製作組準備了一隻價值近二千元的新鮮日本松葉蟹給3位主持發揮，嘉倩同 WinWin 就用了蟹身拆肉同蟹膏去煮麻婆豆腐 。George 從小最愛食片皮鴨，忽發其想就要用松葉蟹蟹鉗蟹腳去弄 「芝士牛油果片皮蟹」。可惜，「蟹肉蟹膏麻婆豆腐」比例完全錯配，豆腐太多，汁太辣，吃不到松葉蟹的鮮味及肉質，徹底嘥料! George 以清淡的牛油果及淡芝士去配松葉蟹，不但沒有搶去蟹的鮮甜，亦食到蟹肉清爽的質感。Christian 在節目中除卻教主持如何不嘥料外，更教大家要物盡其用，他用大家拆肉後 蟹殼、蟹肉、昆布、味醂及珍珠米煲粥，非常美味。

programme.title: Bandai Presents: ULTRAMAN TEO E16 -生命的優先次序 / 超人狄奧 第16集 - 生命的優先次序
On Your Mark E5 -霹靂舞 / 我們與金牌的距離 第5集 - 霹靂舞
programme.desc: Breaking 作為奧運新增項目，到底評分準則及賽制是怎樣的？今集 Phoebus 化身 B-boy Cute ，和香港霹靂舞代表隊「一哥」曾子驊 B-boy Think 一較高下！為了在一對一鬥舞中取勝，B-boy Cute 使出渾身解數及畢生絕學！更令評判 C Plus 嘖嘖稱奇！B-boy Cute 還竟然獲邀成為香港霹靂舞成員的一員？！

programme.title: Wish you good health E144 -足底筋膜炎 / 我想身體健康 第144集 - 足底筋膜炎
programme.desc: #144 當足底發炎，每走一步都疼痛，到底如何生活？今集主持強尼、米露迪、Ash，找來Kira一起請教醫生！到底足底筋膜炎應如何治療？

programme.title: FWD Presents: CHILL CLUB E329 -嘉賓: 張敬軒 / CHILL CLUB 第329集 - 嘉賓: 張敬軒
programme.desc: 本集《CHILL CLUB》請來張敬軒，今集主題是「放棄的界限」。人生總會遇到需要作出取捨的時候，有時明知道應該放手，卻因為仍然在乎，而選擇再等一陣、再試一次。今年張敬軒推出兩首全新作品，以不同角度描寫愛與告別，一首講述難以放下的感情，另一首則將思念化成祝願。此外，節目亦設有「CHILL CLUB 推介榜」，與樂迷一同公布本週第一至第十位推介歌曲。

programme.title: Prudential Hong Kong Tennis Open 2026 -Singles Semi Final[Live] / 保誠香港網球公開賽2026 單打準決賽
programme.desc: 單打準決賽

programme.title: News Cast at 6 with Sign Language / 6點新聞報道 (手語新聞)
Now Forum E1025 / 大鳴大放 第1025集
programme.desc: 《大鳴大放》是一個30分鐘的時事討論節目，識英雄重英雄，請來各界重磅名人，拋出論點，言無不盡，深入討論時事，跨越維港神州，宏觀全世界。

programme.title: TOKUSON: Life Hacks! S6 E11 / 生活小貼士 第11集
Like My Parents E4 / 與父母「同行」 第4集
programme.desc: 有⼀群年輕人，童年的超級英雄不是 Marvel，而是父母的背影。他們選擇走上父母的路，不是因為這條路好行，而是因為這條路「好型」。本節目講述 10 個「粉絲追星」的故事： 這些子女因為崇拜父母而決定長大後也要穿上同⼀套制服，考取同⼀個牌照；亦有人嘗試父母道路後才發現有更適合自己發展的方向、崗位，在這個非家族生意的殘酷職場中，憑實力成為偶像的「同行」，發展出自己的人生。

programme.title: Detective vs Sleuths / 神探大戰
programme.desc: 香港接連出現多宗殘忍至極的兇殺案，死者全是逍遙法外的嫌疑犯，兇手自稱「神探」，私刑執法，挑戰警察。警方立即傾盡隊中的「神探」，成立專案組迎戰。精神病患者李俊(劉青雲 飾)，發病前是警隊的皇牌，當年外號就是「神探」；如今活成廢柴，淪落街頭。為了證明自己不是瘋子，是「神探」，加入戰團，跳進狂徒的佈局，必須跟時間競賽，破盡舊案新案，才能將殺人「神探」緝拿歸案。三方「神探」都為了自己的正義，展開大戰…

programme.title: Chef & My Fridge E36 / 拜託了冰箱 第36集
Be a Better Man E6 -最佳 / 調教你男友 第6集 - 最佳
programme.desc: 在南丫島上兩天，六位男士展現出不同好男友特質，但何謂最佳? 何不來一場即席互選，投票選出誰是最佳男友，勝出更可與女友作短暫交流。常聽說女友覺得甜蜜之事，皆來自於男友細微關心，假若男友們學懂如何替女友吹得一頭好髮，是否就能be a better man? 一切就視乎南丫島「四大美人」是否吹得滿意。

programme.title: Bitter Sweet Hell (Bilingual) E4 / 我們，家 第4集
programme.desc: 盧英媛是大韓民國公認最優秀的家庭心理諮詢醫生，與整形外科醫生丈夫崔宰鎮是所有人都羨慕的夫妻。但突然被不明來歷的神秘女人世娜所威脅，自己曾經令人艷羨的事業與家庭一切都被徹底動搖。為了守護所有家人，開始與作為推理小說作家的家婆洪思江合作守護家人。

programme.title: Good Partner (Bilingual) E17 / 好搭檔 第17集
programme.desc: 講述明星律師車恩京和新人律師之間冰冷而熾熱的法庭辦公室電視劇。描述了面對人生計劃中沒有的意外離別的人們、在解散家庭的瞬間發生的兩難境地。 在冷酷的人生平衡遊戲中，想要選最好的離婚律師們的故事。

programme.title: The Vendetta of An (Bilingual) E10 / 長安二十四計 第10集
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.desc: 講述圍繞著一個女人殺人事件而展開兩個男人的激烈故事，從大眾視角去揭開刑事司法制度。

programme.title: Good Partner (Bilingual) E17 / 好搭檔 第17集
programme.desc: 講述明星律師車恩京和新人律師之間冰冷而熾熱的法庭辦公室電視劇。描述了面對人生計劃中沒有的意外離別的人們、在解散家庭的瞬間發生的兩難境地。 在冷酷的人生平衡遊戲中，想要選最好的離婚律師們的故事。

programme.title: The Vendetta of An (Bilingual) E10 / 長安二十四計 第10集
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: One Ordinary Day (Bilingual) E7 / 某一天 第7集
programme.desc: 講述圍繞著一個女人殺人事件而展開兩個男人的激烈故事，從大眾視角去揭開刑事司法制度。

programme.title: Missing Crown Prince (Bilingual) E2 / 世子消失了 第2集
programme.desc: 王世子被即將成為世子嬪的女人綁架後而發生的一系列故事，在每個瞬間都要拼上性命的逃亡路上，青春男女之間發生的波瀾萬丈，最終逃跑的故事。

programme.title: REBORN (Bilingual) E6 / 重生～最後的英雄～ 第6集
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: Japan's Number One Jerk Salaryman (Bilingual) E6 / 日本第一的爛男人-我的假家人們 第6集
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: REBORN (Bilingual) E6 / 重生～最後的英雄～ 第6集
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: Canned Mackerel Heads to Space (Bilingual) E6 / 鯖魚罐頭，航向宇宙 第6集
programme.desc: 故事改編自真人真事，講述福井縣高中生忽發奇想，希望航天員可在太空站吃到鯖魚罐頭，於是研發「宇宙食品」，更獲宇宙航空研究開發機構（JAXA）認證，並成功送上國際太空站（ISS）的勵志過程。

programme.title: Private Banker (Bilingual) E2 / 私人銀行家 第2集
programme.desc: 主角安野浩一，專為資產超過10億日元的富豪服務，作為「私人銀行家」精心保護客人的財富。他的職業生涯由證券人開始並一步一步成為業界傳奇人物，管理著多名富有客戶的財富。除了資產管理之外，也用一切可能的方式來解決富裕客人面臨的問題，例如家庭成員之間的衝突。

programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: Canned Mackerel Heads to Space (Bilingual) E6 / 鯖魚罐頭，航向宇宙 第6集
programme.desc: 故事改編自真人真事，講述福井縣高中生忽發奇想，希望航天員可在太空站吃到鯖魚罐頭，於是研發「宇宙食品」，更獲宇宙航空研究開發機構（JAXA）認證，並成功送上國際太空站（ISS）的勵志過程。

programme.title: Good Partner (Bilingual) E18 / 好搭檔 第18集
programme.desc: 講述明星律師車恩京和新人律師之間冰冷而熾熱的法庭辦公室電視劇。描述了面對人生計劃中沒有的意外離別的人們、在解散家庭的瞬間發生的兩難境地。 在冷酷的人生平衡遊戲中，想要選最好的離婚律師們的故事。

programme.title: Bitter Sweet Hell (Bilingual) E5 / 我們，家 第5集
programme.desc: 盧英媛是大韓民國公認最優秀的家庭心理諮詢醫生，與整形外科醫生丈夫崔宰鎮是所有人都羨慕的夫妻。但突然被不明來歷的神秘女人世娜所威脅，自己曾經令人艷羨的事業與家庭一切都被徹底動搖。為了守護所有家人，開始與作為推理小說作家的家婆洪思江合作守護家人。

programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: One Ordinary Day (Bilingual) E9 / 某一天 第9集
programme.desc: 講述圍繞著一個女人殺人事件而展開兩個男人的激烈故事，從大眾視角去揭開刑事司法制度。

programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.desc: 講述明星律師車恩京和新人律師之間冰冷而熾熱的法庭辦公室電視劇。描述了面對人生計劃中沒有的意外離別的人們、在解散家庭的瞬間發生的兩難境地。 在冷酷的人生平衡遊戲中，想要選最好的離婚律師們的故事。

programme.title: The Vendetta of An (Bilingual) E17 / 長安二十四計 第17集
programme.desc: 劇情講述文承年間，虎賁暗衛在長安城盤踞多年，勢力已根深蒂固。淮南縣衙主簿謝淮安接到帝王蕭武陽的秘密詔書，被緊急調往國都長安，負責剷除姦佞。虎賁將軍言鳳山不甘心大權旁落，集結虎賁暗衛勢力，企圖分裂國家、自立為王。他利用長安城中的藏兵巷作為掩護，將暗衛分佈其中，伺機反擊。在蕭武陽的協助下，謝淮安聯合忠義將領顧玉、劍客葉崢、畫家白莞及年輕文士謝子凌等人，運用智謀搗毀藏兵巷，粉碎言鳳山妄圖裂國的陰謀，讓長安城重現風朗氣清。

programme.title: One Ordinary Day (Bilingual) E12 / 某一天 第12集
programme.desc: 講述圍繞著一個女人殺人事件而展開兩個男人的激烈故事，從大眾視角去揭開刑事司法制度。

programme.title: Missing Crown Prince (Bilingual) E7 / 世子消失了 第7集
programme.desc: 王世子被即將成為世子嬪的女人綁架後而發生的一系列故事，在每個瞬間都要拼上性命的逃亡路上，青春男女之間發生的波瀾萬丈，最終逃跑的故事。

programme.title: REBORN (Bilingual) E7 / 重生～最後的英雄～ 第7集
programme.desc: 故事背景設定在 2026 年，主角根尾光誠（高橋一生 飾）是一位魅力十足、正值人生巔峰的 IT 公司社長。然而，他卻突然遭遇意外，被人從樓梯上推落導致身亡。 令人意想不到的是，光誠的靈魂並沒有消失，而是跨越時空轉生回到了 14 年前 （2012 年），並附身在一名與自己長相一模一樣、名叫野本英人的青年身上。 與原本「人生勝利組」的社長身份截然不同，野本英人是一名生活在下町商店街、且負債累累的普通百姓。光誠必須以這個全新的身份，在艱難的庶民生活中掙扎求生，同時利用未來的記憶與智慧，試圖查明自己在 2026 年被殺害的真相，並展開一段守護身邊重要之人的「重生」之旅。

programme.title: Japan's Number One Jerk Salaryman (Bilingual) E7 / 日本第一的爛男人-我的假家人們 第7集
programme.desc: 主角大森一平（香取慎吾）是人生被逼到懸崖邊的前播報員，被家人和孩子討壓的最爛男人，為了選舉，和單親爸爸的妹夫及其孩子們一起生活。在面對日常生活中的家庭和社會問題的過程中，最差勁的男人一邊和妹夫和孩子們一點一點地建立起真正的家庭關係，一邊希望逐漸建立更好的社會，不久後努力參加選舉……

programme.title: Eight Hundred E2 / 方圓八百米 第2集
programme.desc: 故事聚焦在上世紀九十年代末的豐陽小鎮礦區。一具無名女屍的出現，打破了表面的平靜，小鎮內的違禁藥品販賣網絡隨之浮出水面。警察陳紅兵緊跟線索，卻步步逼近親生兒子陳輝。在方圓八百公尺的小天地裡，父子間的對抗、職責與親情的糾纏、法律與人性的交纏，讓這個家庭與小城一同面臨善惡的抉擇與考驗。

programme.title: The Heart 2 E2 / 問心 2 第2集
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: Lady Revenger Returns from the Fire E1 / 披荊斬棘的大小姐 第1集
programme.desc: 溫婉恬靜的羅家大小姐羅愛蓮，因突如其來的災難，一夜間失去了一切，從人間富貴花被打入泥潭。經歷重重困境，最終經歷過九死一生的羅愛蓮鳳凰涅槃成為能文能武的鏢局大小姐沈丹青（徐璐飾），從此浴火重生，踏上手撕仇人的荊棘之路，開啟了她的別樣人生。沈丹青在復仇的過程中意外闖入了尋找丟失寶藏的徐將軍（魏哲鳴飾）視野，引起他的懷疑，這使沈丹青的這條復仇之路更加跌宕起伏、與眾不同，兩人在一次次驚心動魄的鬥智中，相互成全，惺惺相惜，發生了一系列扣人心弦的故事。

programme.title: Twilight E34 / 暮色心約 第34集
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: Eight Hundred E2 / 方圓八百米 第2集
programme.desc: 故事聚焦在上世紀九十年代末的豐陽小鎮礦區。一具無名女屍的出現，打破了表面的平靜，小鎮內的違禁藥品販賣網絡隨之浮出水面。警察陳紅兵緊跟線索，卻步步逼近親生兒子陳輝。在方圓八百公尺的小天地裡，父子間的對抗、職責與親情的糾纏、法律與人性的交纏，讓這個家庭與小城一同面臨善惡的抉擇與考驗。

programme.title: Lady Revenger Returns from the Fire E1 / 披荊斬棘的大小姐 第1集
programme.desc: 溫婉恬靜的羅家大小姐羅愛蓮，因突如其來的災難，一夜間失去了一切，從人間富貴花被打入泥潭。經歷重重困境，最終經歷過九死一生的羅愛蓮鳳凰涅槃成為能文能武的鏢局大小姐沈丹青（徐璐飾），從此浴火重生，踏上手撕仇人的荊棘之路，開啟了她的別樣人生。沈丹青在復仇的過程中意外闖入了尋找丟失寶藏的徐將軍（魏哲鳴飾）視野，引起他的懷疑，這使沈丹青的這條復仇之路更加跌宕起伏、與眾不同，兩人在一次次驚心動魄的鬥智中，相互成全，惺惺相惜，發生了一系列扣人心弦的故事。

programme.title: The Heart 2 E2 / 問心 2 第2集

programme.title: Eight Hundred E4 / 方圓八百米 第4集
programme.desc: 故事聚焦在上世紀九十年代末的豐陽小鎮礦區。一具無名女屍的出現，打破了表面的平靜，小鎮內的違禁藥品販賣網絡隨之浮出水面。警察陳紅兵緊跟線索，卻步步逼近親生兒子陳輝。在方圓八百公尺的小天地裡，父子間的對抗、職責與親情的糾纏、法律與人性的交纏，讓這個家庭與小城一同面臨善惡的抉擇與考驗。

programme.title: Royal Rumours E24 / 花琉璃軼聞 第24集
programme.desc: 大晉昌隆年間，剛剛大勝金珀國立下赫赫戰功的護國大將軍花應庭，將掌上明珠唯一的女兒花琉璃先送返京城。自小隨父兄在邊關軍營長大的花琉璃雖是女兒身，但天資聰穎，更習得一身好武藝。然而京城不同於邊關，一方面，花家擁兵自重的謠言甚囂塵上，另一方面，二皇子姬元溯以非長子身份被冊封為太子，又偏不務正業，本已引人側目。本以為走入了風暴眼的花琉璃，卻完全不按套路出牌，一路扮豬吃虎，將人設拗成了病嬌之態，憑藉一己之力手撕名媛圈，更讓太子和金珀皇子拜倒在石榴裙下，硬生生將奪嫡加權謀的大戲劇本改成了一出人間沙雕甜愛劇。

programme.title: Love in Time E1 / 我的秘密室友 第1集
Twilight E38 / 暮色心約 第38集
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker: Red-Moon Pact E21 / 狐妖小紅娘月紅篇 第21集
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

Twilight E39 / 暮色心約 第39集
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

programme.title: The Heart 2 E8 / 問心 2 第8集
programme.desc: 兩年後，周筱風援黔歸來，被破格提拔為東立醫院史上最年輕的心內科執行主任，他與林逸、方筱然重組“三人小分隊”，在全新的職業挑戰與情感考驗中並肩作戰，面對理想與現實的衝突，繼續堅守信念“問心無愧”。

programme.title: Strange Tales of Tang Dynasty E36 / 唐朝詭事錄 第36集
programme.desc: 《唐朝詭事錄》講述了在繁華的大唐盛世之下發生的一系列奇聞異事，長安金吾衛中郎將盧凌風將與狄公親傳弟子蘇無名攜手共破詭案，守護蒼生，擔負起挽救社稷於危急的使命。

programme.title: Fox Spirit Matchmaker: Red-Moon Pact E24 / 狐妖小紅娘月紅篇 第24集
programme.desc: 塗山紅紅與塗山雅雅、塗山容容，都是出生自苦情樹孕育出來的狐族，她們肩負著守護狐族的重任。紅紅作為狐族的領袖，擁有強大的妖力，帶領狐族結緣滋養苦情樹，苦情樹再守護狐族。然而一股黑暗的力量正試圖吞噬苦情樹，為了拯救它，只有完成天書任務才能守護苦情樹。

programme.title: Unchained Love E30 / 浮圖緣 第30集
Eight Hundred E6 / 方圓八百米 第6集
programme.desc: 故事聚焦在上世紀九十年代末的豐陽小鎮礦區。一具無名女屍的出現，打破了表面的平靜，小鎮內的違禁藥品販賣網絡隨之浮出水面。警察陳紅兵緊跟線索，卻步步逼近親生兒子陳輝。在方圓八百公尺的小天地裡，父子間的對抗、職責與親情的糾纏、法律與人性的交纏，讓這個家庭與小城一同面臨善惡的抉擇與考驗。

programme.title: Lady Revenger Returns from the Fire E3 / 披荊斬棘的大小姐 第3集
programme.desc: 溫婉恬靜的羅家大小姐羅愛蓮，因突如其來的災難，一夜間失去了一切，從人間富貴花被打入泥潭。經歷重重困境，最終經歷過九死一生的羅愛蓮鳳凰涅槃成為能文能武的鏢局大小姐沈丹青（徐璐飾），從此浴火重生，踏上手撕仇人的荊棘之路，開啟了她的別樣人生。沈丹青在復仇的過程中意外闖入了尋找丟失寶藏的徐將軍（魏哲鳴飾）視野，引起他的懷疑，這使沈丹青的這條復仇之路更加跌宕起伏、與眾不同，兩人在一次次驚心動魄的鬥智中，相互成全，惺惺相惜，發生了一系列扣人心弦的故事。

programme.title: Twilight E39 / 暮色心約 第39集
programme.desc: 從事心理健康指導工作的劉瑕路遇一名男子想要跳樓，劉瑕見狀便用心理學知識進行疏導，最後成功將該男子救下。這一幕恰巧被正想將自己的心理推理小說改編成劇本的作家祁連山目睹，便力邀劉瑕當顧問。為實現幫助更多人的理想，劉瑕成立了自己的工作室，以出色的專業水準和共情能力，為因事業、家庭或情感問題感到心理壓力的來訪者排憂解困，幫助他們恢復健康積極的生活。祁連山的小說在改編成影視劇的過程中得到了劉瑕的專業指導。隨著兩人接觸不斷加深，他深深地被劉瑕吸引。劉瑕工作之餘，與天才極客沈欽合作開發AI心理測試系統，並將之應用於兒童及社區公益，效果極佳。祁連山也逐漸參與到劉瑕的公益事業中，一起幫助那些面臨生活挑戰的人走出心理困境。二人在一次次攜手合作中越走越近，最終在各自事業都取得成功的同時，也收穫了美好的愛情。

Two Stars, One Boss E6 -「特種兵」行程累懵胡軍李乃文 / 大哥小助理 第6集 - 「特種兵」行程累懵胡軍李乃文
programme.desc: 兩位50+娛樂圈前輩胡軍、李乃文化身為經理人團隊，為具有代表性的年輕後輩藝人擔任經理人，全面負責藝人的行程安排，從接送機、行程對接、妝髮準備到工作陪伴、突發危機處理...等；他們需要動用自己的人生智慧和圈內經驗，為藝人保駕護航。

programme.title: Live and Love Season 2 E9 -盛大告白夜？ / 勢均力敵的我們 第2季 第9集 - 盛大告白夜？
programme.desc: 以「尋找勢均力敵的參與者」為核心模式，通過團隊協作任務獲取生存物資，個人競技爭奪約會權，並設置淘汰機制與心動投票綁定規則；素人嘉賓們將逃離都市，直面愛情與生存的挑戰，在人群中尋找勢均力敵的彼此。

programme.title: Fantastic Journey Season 2 E10 -領隊何廣智首次出國游倍感焦慮 / 非來不可 第2季 第10集 - 領隊何廣智首次出國游倍感焦慮
programme.desc: 孟非、劉震雲決心效仿中國最早的自由行「西遊」，攜何廣智、李雅娟升級為「非震式旅行社」；邀請尹正、哈妮克孜、武藝、張雨綺、楊迪、楊超越等飛行嘉賓，先後到達喀什，塔什庫爾干，獨庫公路，烏茲別克斯坦等地，串聯起雪山草原、戈壁大漠、城市綠洲，開啟一場前所未有的奇遇之旅。

programme.title: Perfect Match Season 16 E41 -大連男孩鐘情環海旅遊 / 非誠勿擾 第16季 第41集 - 大連男孩鐘情環海旅遊
programme.desc: 《非誠勿擾》回歸經典規則。男嘉賓登場後，將通過「愛之請回答」「愛之再判斷」「愛之終決選」三個環節與24位女嘉賓互相了解，還有根據大數據匹配的「智推女生」參與最終決選。陳銘、黃瀾加盟「非誠合夥人」，以全新視角解讀愛情。

programme.title: Melody Journey (Repackaged) E5 -周深單依純為愛爭歌 / 音樂緣計劃 第5集 - 周深單依純為愛爭歌
programme.desc: 首檔原創音樂創演節目，邀請了薛之謙、張靚穎、周深、單依純、黃子弘凡等歌手，同時更邀請小柯、方文山、黃國倫等樂壇前輩和眾多新生代原創音樂人加盟；由歌曲爭奪戰、首演舞台兩大核心環節組成，用一場歌手與歌曲的奇遇，為他們提供一個自由共創的舞台，打造華語樂壇新的高光時刻。

programme.title: Sing! Asia (Repackaged) E2 -馬來西亞周深驚艷Jessie J / 亞洲新聲 第2集 - 馬來西亞周深驚艷Jessie J
programme.desc: 突破傳統音樂綜藝節目模式，創新性地將舞台設立在郵輪上，從中國上海啟航，途經沖繩、越南、新加坡、馬來西亞，最終抵達香港；吸納數百名來自亞洲各國的00後新銳唱將，他們將在Jessie J、張靚穎、張信哲、尤長靖所組成的「新聲團」，及近百位亞洲各國音樂人的見證下，開啟一次巡迴亞洲的音樂競演！

programme.title: Her Prime Season 2 E11 -小鹿帶娃無痛當媽 / 姐姐當家 第2季 第11集 - 小鹿帶娃無痛當媽
programme.desc: 以「姐姐當家，愛是什麼」為主題，集結杜華、房主任、冉瑩穎、小鹿、徐夢桃五位當家姐姐，以更加豐富的人生樣本回應當代女性共同面對的生活課題；觀察團成員李維嘉、倪萍、倪子君、張泉靈回歸，共同組成多元觀察體系，從專業視角與大眾視角出發，共同尋找愛是什麼的答案。

programme.title: Wildfire (Mini drama) E29 / 野火 (短劇) 第29集
programme.desc: 戲子沈慕靈為追查師父離奇死亡的真相，結識了外表玩世不恭、內心滿懷熱血的富家公子關行楷，兩人從最初的相互猜忌試探，到後來並肩作戰，在繁華鬧市的硝煙暗湧中，利用梨園戲台傳遞情報；他們不僅查明了真相，更在家國危難之際挺身而出，如星星野火般在亂世中燃燒自己，守護心中大義。

programme.title: Flying Up Without Disturb (Mini drama) E48 / 勿擾飛升 (短劇) 第48集
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.title: Who's Still Standing Youth Edition Season 2 E3 -龐博解鎖棋局博弈 / 一站到底 少年季 第2季 第3集 - 龐博解鎖棋局博弈
programme.desc: 張泉靈、黃聖依等擔任少年見證官，在賽制內容上進行升級，分為搶位賽、團隊輪答賽、項目挑戰賽三個環節，圍繞真實生活場景與綜合性課題，著重考驗自主探究與協作破題的綜合能力；題庫覆蓋校內學科、傳統文化、時事邏輯等多領域，讓少年們在解題中感受思考的樂趣，在挑戰中養成自主探究的習慣。

programme.desc: 突破傳統音樂綜藝節目模式，創新性地將舞台設立在郵輪上，從中國上海啟航，途經沖繩、越南、新加坡、馬來西亞，最終抵達香港；吸納數百名來自亞洲各國的00後新銳唱將，他們將在Jessie J、張靚穎、張信哲、尤長靖所組成的「新聲團」，及近百位亞洲各國音樂人的見證下，開啟一次巡迴亞洲的音樂競演！

programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.title: She Is the Phoenix (Mini drama) E1 / 迎鳳歸 (短劇) 第1集

programme.title: Melody Journey (Repackaged) E6 -「唱跳歌手」周深再度上線 / 音樂緣計劃 第6集 - 「唱跳歌手」周深再度上線
programme.desc: 首檔原創音樂創演節目，邀請了薛之謙、張靚穎、周深、單依純、黃子弘凡等歌手，同時更邀請小柯、方文山、黃國倫等樂壇前輩和眾多新生代原創音樂人加盟；由歌曲爭奪戰、首演舞台兩大核心環節組成，用一場歌手與歌曲的奇遇，為他們提供一個自由共創的舞台，打造華語樂壇新的高光時刻。

programme.title: Sing! Asia (Repackaged) E3 -張靚穎張信哲工藤靜香合唱 / 亞洲新聲 第3集 - 張靚穎張信哲工藤靜香合唱
programme.desc: 突破傳統音樂綜藝節目模式，創新性地將舞台設立在郵輪上，從中國上海啟航，途經沖繩、越南、新加坡、馬來西亞，最終抵達香港；吸納數百名來自亞洲各國的00後新銳唱將，他們將在Jessie J、張靚穎、張信哲、尤長靖所組成的「新聲團」，及近百位亞洲各國音樂人的見證下，開啟一次巡迴亞洲的音樂競演！

programme.title: Her Prime Season 2 E12 -冉瑩穎不排斥生四胎 / 姐姐當家 第2季 第12集 - 冉瑩穎不排斥生四胎
programme.desc: 以「姐姐當家，愛是什麼」為主題，集結杜華、房主任、冉瑩穎、小鹿、徐夢桃五位當家姐姐，以更加豐富的人生樣本回應當代女性共同面對的生活課題；觀察團成員李維嘉、倪萍、倪子君、張泉靈回歸，共同組成多元觀察體系，從專業視角與大眾視角出發，共同尋找愛是什麼的答案。

programme.title: She Is the Phoenix (Mini drama) E4 / 迎鳳歸 (短劇) 第4集
programme.desc: 圍繞雙重生的復仇主線展開，女主角姜樂瑤慘死後重生，發現閨蜜蓉兒頂替了自己的身份嫁入寧府，前一世她被嫁給痴傻少爺，更發現父母並非死於意外而是被人所害；這一世，她與同樣重生的伙伴聯手，直面寧府權貴的迫害，在身份置換與權謀博弈中揭露真相，為自己討回公道。

programme.title: Flying Up Without Disturb (Mini drama) E53 / 勿擾飛升 (短劇) 第53集
programme.desc: 一位在凡塵界備受冷遇的亡國公主箜篌，因機緣巧合意外進入修仙世界，開啟全員寵女主模式，整個修仙界都對女主寵愛有加，為了吃苦頭，磨練心智，箜篌主動走出舒適圈，要求下山闖蕩，偶遇了病弱男子桓宗一起升級打怪闖蕩修仙界，沒想到桓宗竟然是傳說中的修仙界天才，箜篌順利把桓宗拐回了門派當女婿，兩人也在一次次的歷練中克服了心魔，突破修為，雙雙成為了一代宗師。

programme.title: Who's Still Standing Youth Edition Season 2 E4 -語言密碼解鎖 / 一站到底 少年季 第2季 第4集 - 語言密碼解鎖
programme.desc: 張泉靈、黃聖依等擔任少年見證官，在賽制內容上進行升級，分為搶位賽、團隊輪答賽、項目挑戰賽三個環節，圍繞真實生活場景與綜合性課題，著重考驗自主探究與協作破題的綜合能力；題庫覆蓋校內學科、傳統文化、時事邏輯等多領域，讓少年們在解題中感受思考的樂趣，在挑戰中養成自主探究的習慣。

programme.title: Two Stars, One Boss E7 -陳哲遠提醒老胡小李謹記自己身份 / 大哥小助理 第7集 - 陳哲遠提醒老胡小李謹記自己身份
programme.desc: 兩位50+娛樂圈前輩胡軍、李乃文化身為經理人團隊，為具有代表性的年輕後輩藝人擔任經理人，全面負責藝人的行程安排，從接送機、行程對接、妝髮準備到工作陪伴、突發危機處理...等；他們需要動用自己的人生智慧和圈內經驗，為藝人保駕護航。

programme.title: Live and Love Season 2 E10 -付出的真心變笑話？ / 勢均力敵的我們 第2季 第10集 - 付出的真心變笑話？
programme.desc: 以「尋找勢均力敵的參與者」為核心模式，通過團隊協作任務獲取生存物資，個人競技爭奪約會權，並設置淘汰機制與心動投票綁定規則；素人嘉賓們將逃離都市，直面愛情與生存的挑戰，在人群中尋找勢均力敵的彼此。

programme.title: Masterpiece in Jiangnan Season 3 E6 / 藝江南 第3季 第6集
programme.desc: 聚焦中國優秀文化傳統，講述文化名家和文藝人才的故事及師徒傳習技藝的過程，記錄與展現“名師帶徒”計畫創作成果。

programme.title: Traditional Chinese Medicine Youth Chronicles Season 3 E7 -國醫少年團學護肺常識 / 國醫少年志 第3季 第7集 - 國醫少年團學護肺常識
programme.desc: 由陳妍希、夏之光、高卿塵、李雅娟組成國醫少年團，帶著對中醫文化的虔誠與需求，踏上制定的研學體驗地圖，遇見不同行醫風格的中醫師，與他們同吃同住，同苦同樂，深度體驗中醫藥從業者的工作艱辛，學習簡易上手的健康養生功法，從中體驗和領悟中醫藥的博大精深。

programme.title: Travel through Jiangsu Season 3 E19 / 遊遍江蘇 第3季 第19集
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: Travel through Jiangsu Season 4 E31 / 遊遍江蘇 第4季 第31集
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: Travel through Jiangsu Season 4 E32 / 遊遍江蘇 第4季 第32集
programme.desc: 遊遍江蘇全省的名勝古蹟和大街小巷，尋訪文史學家、學者，走訪民間藝人工匠等，探尋風景背後的動人故事，深度觸摸江蘇的文化脈搏，帶領大家發現江蘇的獨特魅力。

programme.title: Love Never Comes Late Season 4 E81 / 緣來不晚 第4季 第81集
programme.desc: 專為資深單身人士定制的相親交友節目，每集有4位男嘉賓和3位女嘉賓，依序進行一對一交流。未上場嘉賓則分別在男女嘉賓室觀察場上溝通情況，加深對有意對象的瞭解。節目主張為愛回歸，愛情不分年齡，緣來從來不晚。

programme.title: The National Dog Show ('20)
programme.desc: From the Kennel Club of Philadelphia, this cherished competition for all dog lovers returns for the 17th year. Hosted by John O'Hurley, the event features 2,000 of the nation's leading canines, including the world’s largest, smallest and most exotic. Over 170 breeds strut their stuff with the hope of becoming this year's top dog. “The Dean” David Frei provides expert show commentary, and Mary Carillo chimes in as an adept sideline reporter for this ultimate canine showdown. But which dog will have their day, and which will leave with their tail between their legs? After all, there can only be one “Best in Show”.

programme.desc: In this ferocious retelling of the Battle of Thermopylae based on the epic graphic novel by Frank Miller, King Xerxes of Persia amasses an army of hundreds of thousands, drawn from Asia and Africa, to invade and conquer the tiny, divided nation of Greece in 481 B.C.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles / 忍者龜
programme.desc: Four humanoid turtles emerge from the sewers of New York City to fight a gang of teenage ninjas, lead by a mysterious Japanese martial artist.

programme.title: The Monkey King 2 / 西遊記之孫悟空三打白骨精
programme.desc: 500 years after the havoc in heaven, Xuanzang, the Tang Priest, is appointed by the Buddha to go to the West to fetch the Buddhist scriptures. By accident, Xuangzang undoes the Buddha's spell on Sun Wukong, the Monkey King. Wukong brought under control by a gold hoop given by the Mercy Goddess. He has no choice but to accept the mission to escort Xuanzang to the West. Despite his reluctance. Wukong cuts paths all the way and dutifully helps to subdue Bajie and Sha. But the hoop on this head, effective with his master's restrictive incantation, always remains a vexation for Wukong. Lady White Bone Spirit from the White Tiger Ridge aims to kill and eat Xuanzang's golden body for evading her doom of reincarnation from a demon to any other creature. After dealing with the four, White Bone Spirit has an insight into the barrier between Wukong and Xuanzang. So, she designs traps to foment discord between them. Humiliated mistakenly, Wukong still fights on with both strength and wit

programme.title: BODIES AT REST / 沉默的證人
programme.desc: A cat-and-mouse game unfolds over a single night when three armed criminals barge into a morgue, demanding the forensic doctor and his assistant to hand over a bullet lodged inside a corpse. While the criminals are in a desperate attempt to hide their true identities, the doctor finds himself sinking deeper and deeper into a quagmire as his past inadvertently catches up with him. Each explosive twist soon pushes the characters beyond their limits.

programme.title: Christmas Rose / 聖誕玫瑰
programme.desc: Tim is a defence attorney with a heart of gold. Refusing to be simply a hired gun for his clients, he quits his high-powered job to become a prosecutor for the Justice Department. With the support of fiancee Megan and cop buddy Nam, Tim decides to start afresh. When he meets a handicapped piano teacher, Jing, who urges him to help her. She is accusing her doctor, Zhou a renowned surgeon of sexual harassment during a routine check-up. But with no witnesses and only their own conflicting testimonies, a Rashomon-like mystery unfolds. To make matters worse, Zhou's defence attorney, Freddy, is Tim's successor at his old law firm, and proves to be Tim's toughest opponent to-date. As a media frenzy encircles the case, it slowly destroys the lives of everyone involved.

programme.title: The Confidence Man JP: Episode of the Hero / 信用欺詐師JP：英雄篇
programme.desc: The “Third Generation Tsuchinoko” -- the master con man hailed as a “hero” has died. Dako, Boku-chan and Richard all honed their skills under his tutelage. The title of 'Tsuchinoko' is handed down in secrecy to the Confidence Man (scammer) with the greatest skill, setting the stage for a showdown between his three star pupils. The contest will take place in the world heritage city of Valletta, Malta, an international gathering place for the rich and famous.Their target is the invaluable ancient Greek sculpture “Dancing Venus”, currently owned by a wealthy, retired Spanish gangster. Each scammer adopts a unique strategy in pursuit of the target, but the police and Interpol are also hot on their heels. Who will laugh last?! No one knows how the biggest scam in history will end! Who is the true 'hero' and what is the ultimate 'truth'? The last con game, grand finale, Battle Royale...begins now!

programme.title: Coffee or Tea? / 一點就到家
programme.desc: This is a youth-comedy version of American Dreams in China (2013). Wei Jinbei (played by Liu Haoran), Peng Xiubing (Peng Yuchang) and Li Shaoqun (Yin Fang) are young men of very different personalities. One had tried many times to find success in e-commerce but had failed on every turn in a big city. The other is a village lad, with nothing on his mind but the chase for success. The third one is consumed by romantic visions of life, divorced entirely from reality. They had separately returned from the city to an antiquated town in Yunnan. Brought together by fate, they decided to launch an e-commerce business together. They might have stumbled upon a great idea, but the state-of-the-art nature of their technological pursuit puts them at odds with the fogeyish ways of the very traditional town. With resolve and sincerity, they managed to win over everyone, entering into the eventful journey of a tech startup, a journey at once earnest, vibrant and surreal!

programme.title: Love in the Big City / 戀愛大都會
programme.desc: Searching for true love in this prejudiced world. Jae-hee is a free-spirited girl who often becomes the center of rumors, while her classmate Heung-soo struggles to hide his true identity. One night at the bar district, Jae-hee discovers the other side of Heung-soo that no one else knows and helps him keep it a secret in public. As Heung-soo accidentally becomes Jae-hee's roommate, they realize that despite not being each other's ideal types, their companionship fosters a deep and strong friendship. Together, they navigate life's unexpected challenges and rely on each other like family as they courageously pursue their own paths in love and life.

programme.title: Suspect / 超意神探
programme.desc: Due to a hypnosis murder case, a former policeman Guo WenBin with hyperthymesia gets involved with a highly intelligent murderer challenging judicial justice. The suspect openly challenges the law and claims to be a vigilante, using bizarre means to eradicate violence. There is panic among the general public, with lives at stake and much doubt floating around. With his extraordinary memory, he works hard to uncover the mystery of this police-versus-criminal game. Hypnotized at the decisive moment, he uses his subconscious to fight against the instigation of his dark side “Suspect Zero”. He uncovers the truth about the murder and the tragedy behind it, curbing the dark side of human nature and upholding judicial justice. While redeeming himself, he also brings the real culprit to justice.

programme.title: The Exchange / 冤鴦大盜
programme.desc: Dojo and May are a loving couple. Because Dojo has a brain tumor and needs 1 million baht for the operation, they decide to rob a money exchange store. Unluckily, the couple with 10 unfortunate patrons of the money exchange center are held hostages by 3 professional robbers on the same day. It is a robbery inside another robbery as well as some secrets among these people will be revealed. What could possibly happen when these people are trapped in the store with no way to escape?

programme.title: Stars in Focus: Tse Kwan Ho: A Guilty Conscience / 爆谷巨星匯：謝君豪: 毒舌大狀
programme.desc: In a moment of irresponsible negligence, sharp-tongued barrister Adrian Lam mishandles a child abuse case and indirectly sentences the innocent Jolene Tsang to prison for 17 years. Falling from disgrace, Adrian decides to serve the public and defend the commoners, until an unlikely opportunity for appeal surfaces. Determined to right his wrong, Adrian gathers former partners Evelyn Fong and Prince to free Jolene, but that would mean fighting against the tycoons, Victoria and Desmond Chung, who also have barrister James Tung as their private consultant. With pressure from media and police, and facing tough cross examination from prosecutor Kam Yuen Shan in court, how will Adrian uphold justice and punish the true culprit?

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E284 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第284集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Come Back Home / 搜救
programme.desc: De and his family are on a self-driving tour heading to Northeast Changbai Mountain during a chilling winter, unfortunately the happy holiday goes tragic after De lost his 8 years old son by mistake. De and his wife seek for help from the police, and the rescue mission begins. The rescue process in the mountains and the ice lakes gets dangerous as time goes by due to the bad weather. The golden rescue time has passed after 24 hours, then the standard safe limit of rescue of 48 hours has also passed. However, the child still hasn't been found. Even with the slightest chance to save the boy, De and rescue teams from the police and the snow field refuse to give their mission up. Will they see the miracle of life eventually?

programme.title: The White Dragon / 小白龍情海翻波
programme.desc: 'Little White Dragon', a noblewoman and a kung fu hero whose beauty soon caught the eyes of the crown prince. He sent White Dragon to capture an assassin, a blind swordsman...

programme.title: Back Home / 七月返歸
programme.desc: Heung Wing has been sensitive to paranormal activity and keeps seeing ghosts since he was a kid, which is called having “Yin Yang” eyes. To avoid being excluded by his peer, he was taught to pretend nothing happened, even though he knew their existence. He then left from Hong Kong to Canada because of his miserable childhood. One day, Heung Wing is told that his mother has been in coma by committing suicide, which forces him to return to Hong Kong. When he goes back to the old home, everything looks strange and unfamiliar to him. What's more horrifying is, a series of weird cases happen in the neighbourhood, and ghosts show up in front of him again. The situation is deteriorating beyond his imagination...

programme.title: The Rising Star -Tang Lai Ying / 我要做接班人 -鄧麗英
programme.desc: Tang Lai Ying, known as “All-bad-angles pretty girl”, played a club girl-wannabe waitress in the film “Night King” and her comedic performance has won the audience's favor. Despite her cheerful and optimistic personality both on and off screen, she has experienced confusion on her journey to pursue her dreams. Despite of the popularity of her comedic image, she also longs for audiences to see her serious side. In this programme, Lai Ying is going to share her philosophy on happiness, giving everyone a glimpse of her most authentic self.

programme.title: Dark Nuns / 驅魔黑修女
programme.desc: Are you ready to venture into the forbidden? Sister Giunia is convinced that the evil spirit possessing Hee-joon is one of the 12 Manifestations. With the exorcist priest unable to come in time and Hee-joon's life clearly at risk, Sister Giunia decides to break a sacred rule: ‘An unordained nun cannot perform an exorcism.' However, Father Paolo, Hee-joon's attending physician, firmly believes that only medicine can save the boy. When Sister Giunia discovers a secret about Father Paolo's disciple, Sister Michela, she recklessly seeks her help to smuggle Hee-joon out of the hospital. Despite clashing with the fearless Giunia, Michela, feeling a connection to the boy, decides to join forces. Together, the two nuns embark on a dangerous ritual, determined to save the boy at all costs, no matter the risks or consequences. There's only one rule: Save him at all cost!

programme.title: Go For Broke / 重生
programme.desc: In a secluded corner of Mancheng City, a ruthless drug trafficking group stops at nothing to achieve their goals, leading to countless individuals falling into the abyss of shattered families due to drug addiction. Zhang Yao, who has been persecuted by drug traffickers to the point of losing everything, seeks revenge. He secretly collaborates with Captain An Du of the anti-drug squad to set up a ruthless trap to eliminate the top bosses of the criminal syndicate. However, behind this plan lies a carefully orchestrated game of revenge. Do they have the same enemy or do they each have their own hidden agendas? In this showdown, who is truly in control, and who is merely a pawn being manipulated? As the crisis looms, will they sink or awaken to reality? Proceed with caution as everything unfolds...

programme.title: Monster / 怪物
programme.desc: When her young son Minato starts to behave strangely, his mother feels that there is something wrong. Discovering that a teacher is responsible, she storms into the school demanding to know what's going on. But as the story unfolds through the eyes of mother, teacher and child, the truth gradually emerges.

Yi-jung does not believe Su-kyung's claim that the car suddenly accelerated on its own and thinks her mother hit her on purpose. Now, Yi-jung wants an apology from Su-kyung for everything that happened in her life.

programme.desc: When Kyuta, a young orphan living on the streets of Shibuya, stumbles into a fantastic world of beasts, he's taken in by Kumatetsu, a gruff, rough-around-the-edges warrior beast who's been searching for the perfect apprentice. Despite their constant bickering, Kyuta and Kumatetsu begin training together and slowly form a bond as surrogate father and son. But when a deep darkness threatens to throw the human and beast worlds into chaos, the strong bond between this unlikely pair will be put to the ultimate test-a final showdown that will only be won if the two can finally work together using all of their combined strength and courage.

All of a sudden, Sze-to's pub turns into an arena where the greatest Judo fighters show off their skills.... Sze-to will take on his opponents with everything he's got.

He later attempted to commit suicide but was unsuccessful, and was eventually sentenced to rehabilitate in a psychiatric facility indefinitely. Dr. CHOW (HUANG Xiao Ming) is FAN's psychiatrist. He believes FAN is cured after 3-year treatment and is alone in opposition to all doctors' objections to discharge FAN. After releasing from the facility, FAN faces discrimination and misunderstanding and once again finds himself at the brink of collapse. One night, he mistakenly kills a drug addict on impulse. He is driven to despair and comes to Dr. CHOW for help.Having thought about it, Dr CHOW fears his career will be wrecked if it is uncovered and therefore helps FAN abscond. The concealment of the truth subtly snowballs into chaos as it triggers media criticism and attacks due to his missing murderous patient. programme.title: Masquerade Night / 假面之夜
programme.desc: An anonymous letter is delivered to the police – a warning that the killer involved in a mysterious homicide that occurred a few days ago in a condominium in Tokyo will strike again at “Masquerade Night”, the New Year's Eve countdown party held at Hotel Cortesia, Tokyo. All 500 invitees will be in costume. Everyone is a suspect. As the masked guests begin to arrive, they struggle to find a clue which will lead them to the murderer. Midnight draws near as the number of suspects increases. What is the killer's intention? Who is the informant? Will Nitta and Yamagishi be able to unveil the truth hidden behind the murderer's mask before the time limit?

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E285 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第285集 -寒戰 1994

programme.title: Don't Buy The Seller / 千萬別開門
programme.desc: ‘Soo-hyun' buys a used washing machine online after moving into her new place. When she receives a broken machine, she realizes she's been scammed and decides to make sure the seller doesn't get away with it! Eventually, Soo-hyun succeeds in finding the seller's online account, then leaves warnings that he is a fraudster under all his posts to stop him from selling. From then on, terrifying things start to happen to Soo-hyun. She led on ordinary life with an ordinary job, but everything in her daily life begins to fall apart, and an investigation to find the seller unfolds. Later, Soo-hyun goes to the seller's pace with Detective Joo, and discovers a dead body...

programme.title: Back to the Past / 尋秦記
programme.desc: A wrongful imprisonment leads to a crisis that can change the course of history! To make up for his wrongful imprisonment, Ken vows to travel to the Qin dynasty and become the Qin Emperor. Meanwhile, in the Qin Dynasty, Hong Siu-lung and his family have spent the last two decades in seclusion, but his every move is still being watched by his disciple, the Qin Emperor. Just as the emperor is on the cusp of ultimate power after conquering the six rival warring states, he is ambushed by Ken and his team. With nowhere else to go, he turns to Hong, the mentor that he both reveres and fears, for safety, reuniting them for the first time in 20 years. As Ken binds these men's fate once more, the emperor and Hong's long-standing grudge must be settled once and for all.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Deconstructing the Cold War Universe / 爆谷製造 -拆解寒戰宇宙
programme.desc: Director Longman Leung is here to shed light on the mysteries of the “Cold War” series. What actually does the operation codename “Cold War” mean? Longman reveals that not a single shot had been fired in the first script while the foreshadowing in dialogue of 'Cold War' and 'Cold War 2' are going to be revealed in the sequel! Let's find out more behind-the-scenes stories of the “Cold War” series shared by Longman.

programme.title: Lady Cop & Papa Crook / 大搜查之女
programme.desc: Senior Inspector Molline Szeto is assigned to investigate the kidnap of a boy, whose father is the kingpin of illegal red oil, John Fok.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E291 -Dust to Dust / 爆谷電影現場 第291集 -第八個嫌疑人
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: The Beast Stalker / 証人
programme.desc: A traffic accident changed their lives forever. In capturing wanted criminal Zhang Yidong, Sergeant Tang Fei was involved in a gunfight and car accident that put the criminal in a coma. But in the process he also crippled an fellow officer, and mistakenly shot dead the elder daughter of public prosecutor and single mother Gao Min. Unable to handle the guilt, Tang Fei succumbs to a fog of pain. Gao Min, meanwhile, pours all her love and attention to her younger daughter Ling. Three months later, the criminal Zhang Yidong awakens from his coma. Gao Min, who had been working hard on bringing him to justice, insists he stand trial immediately.

programme.title: Old Boy (Digital Restored Version) / 原罪犯 (數碼修復版)
programme.desc: One night in 1988, ordinary-man OH Dae-su, who lives with his wife and an adorable baby daughter, is kidnapped. He later wakes up to find himself in a private makeshift prison. While suffering from his debacle, Dae-su becomes shocked when he watches the news and hears that his beloved wife was brutally murdered. 15 years later, Dae-su is released and he determines to find out the truth. He meets Mi-do, the cook of the restaurant Dae-su has his first-meal after his imprisonment, and tells her about his 15 years in confinement. Mi-do promises to help him seek vengeance. As the team approaches the truth, another shocking-secret is revealing....

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E294 -Back to the Past / 爆谷電影現場 第294集 -尋秦記
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: A Simple Life / 桃姐
programme.desc: Ms. Zhong Chun-tao had served the Leung's family as a domestic helper since the age of 13. Time went fast and the past sixty years flew by. During this time, some members of the Leung's family had passed away, whilst the rest had emigrated and left the country for good. For the past decade, sister Tao and the only successor of the family, Roger, were the sole remaining members. The master-servant relationship between the two was well and supportive through mutual understanding, but lack of proper communication. One day thereafter, sister Tao was found suffering from...

programme.title: Summer Wars / 夏日大作戰
programme.desc: Worlds collide in a tale where virtual reality meets actual reality. When Kenji Koiso is pulled from Oz, a popular social networking realm, to play fiance to classmate Natsuki, he faces a mess of challenges. Between the boisterous and bickering characters of the Jinnouchi clan and the sudden chaos in Oz, Kenji and his new companions must learn the importance of coming together to face the toughest of odds.

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News / OMG！阿媽有喜
programme.desc: Rita, 53, and her husband Siu Hung were planning their retirement when they suddenly discovered that they were pregnant! Both the couple wanted to have the child removed, but they didn't know how to tell each other. Until at a family dinner, two children accidentally discovered the secret of their mother, and the reaction was uproar. At the same time, Siu Hung's sister-Fuk Ling returned from abroad and decided to move in with everyone. The incompatible relationship between sister-in-law and sister-in-law suddenly plunged the Lee family into a chaotic dispute. In anger, Rita decided to become a senior mother and decided to give birth to the child in her belly. The peaceful and well-off family began an unprecedented 'big reform'. However, during this wonderful pregnancy process, everyone began to become different because of this sudden little life...including Fuk Ling, who had been married for many years but did not want to have children; his otaku son who was not good at expre

programme.title: Handsome Guys / 沒有美色殺人狂
programme.desc: 'Do we lacking anything? We have a house, a truck, and very attractive.' Self-proclaimed tough guy Jae-pil and sexy guy Sang-gu leave an unforgettable first impression on their moving day. Despite becoming special surveillance targets for Police Chief Choi and Officer Nam, they are simply happy to start anew in their European-style dream house. However, happiness is short-lived as they are inadvertently mistaken for kidnappers while trying to rescue Mina, who almost drowns. Meanwhile, uninvited guests looking for Mina start appearing, and an ancient spirit sealed in the basement awakens, surrounding the house with dark energy.

programme.title: The White Storm 3: Heaven or Hell / 掃毒3: 人在天涯
programme.desc: Hong Kong police agent Cheung works undercover in Kang's drug cartel, while another undercover cop Au successfully earns their trust in an incident, a brotherly-bond is built among the three. After the Police busts the syndicate in Hong Kong, Kang subsequently hide away in the Golden Triangle, by chance he receives a tip-off about the betrayal within his circle of trust...

programme.title: Haw / 好狗不見了Haw
programme.desc: Tamio Akanishi is a hapless public servant who has just hit the low point of his life having been dumped by his fiancee. He spends his days living alone in a big house he had bought for a married life that never materialized. At the recommendation of his concerned boss, he adopts a large white dog that had been abandoned by a previous owner who had mistreated him. The dog can only eke out a raspy whisper due to having had his vocal cords removed. Tamio names the extremely loving and trusting dog 'Haw' for the sound he makes, and thus begins the rapturously joyful life of a man and his dog.

programme.title: Soul Mate / 七月與安生
programme.desc: Qiyue and Ansheng are two high school best friends. Qiyue is calm like water while Ansheng is a fiery ball of passion. As fate would have it, they fall in love with the same man, Jia-ming. Because of their different values and lifestyles, they are destined to arrive at two completely different endings...

programme.title: Alienoid / 祖宗膠戰外星人
programme.desc: In the year 2022, Guard and Thunder live on Earth, managing alien prisoners who have been locked up in humans' brains. One day, a spacecraft appears in the sky over Seoul, and the police detective Moon witnesses a strange sight...Meanwhile 630 years earlier during the Goryeo Dynasty, the hapless dosa (Korean tao magician) Muruk and Ean, the so-called “The Girl Who Shoots Thunder”, each scramble to outwit each other in pursuit of the mystical Divine Blade, for which a huge reward is being offered. Two sorcerers in search of the Divine Blade's secrets, Madam Black and Mr. Blue, as well as the masked Jajang, also set out on a desperate scramble to obtain the Blade. Meanwhile, a spacecraft emerges from a deep river, emitting light...Those who pursue alien prisoners locked in human bodies in the year 2022, and the sorcerers who pursue the legendary Divine Blade in the year 1391... When the door of time opens, everything becomes entangled!

programme.title: Blind Detective / 盲探
programme.desc: The crime-solver in the Police Crime Unit CHONG was forced to quit four years ago after he got blind accidentally and since then has worked as a private eye on cold cases to earn rewards for a living. He has spent nine months investigating the suspect for the Mongkok Acid Attack Case but was caught in a dire situation during an operation. Fortunately he was saved by a woman detective TUNG in the nick of time...

programme.title: CYBERHEIST / 斷網
programme.desc: A menacing forest of fiber and data lies behind every digital screen. The Internet, while having given birth to many innovations, is also the nest of deadly computer viruses.Around the world, on a daily basis malicious hackers attack firewalls holding Governments, private companies and citizens hostage. However, not even the strongest of the hackers can do in Chun, a genius cyber security engineer who can fend off any attack with his innovative, self-developed protective firewall system. In an attempt to bring him down, unfortunately Chun gets caught up in a money laundering operation where he discovers that his boss Chi is behind the attack. To fight Chi and regain his integrity and credibility, Chun has to venture into the dark web where he can deploy an all-powerful AI virus that he created; along the way taking down violent hit-men and hackers in order to uncover the evidence of Chi's crimes. In the meantime, Chi attempts to seize Chun's technology, further resorting to

programme.title: The Case - Death Drugs / 重案行動之搗毒任務
programme.desc: A young girl died of drug addiction, revealing that a new type of drug is spreading rapidly in Hong Kong, affecting young people. The police take the incident seriously and set up an elite team from various departments to eradicate the entire drug cartel. The team investigated from various aspects of tracking, undercover, and forensics, and finally found that the mastermind behind turned out to be a genius drug refiner.

programme.title: Pretty Heart / 心裏美
programme.desc: Mr. K.K. Ho, is a leading “star tutor” with remarkable achievements. Lee Lung Kei , the stingy boss and principal of the cram school, regards Mr. Ho as a trump card. Chloe, a traditional high school teacher, has always tried her best in teaching. Chloe despises K.K.'s teaching methods and refers to them as deviant. The two of them give tit for tat in class. Their conflict leads to K.K.'s appreciation for Chloe. He gives her flowers as an apology, but Chloe never accepts. He finds out Chloe is the daughter of Principal Lee. When she was young, she witnessed her mother being bullied and died by accident. That is why she deeply hates her father and refuses to get in touch with him. K.K. with wisdom and courage, who breaks through all the obstacles to pursue Chloe but also takes into account the father-daughter relationship. However, he learns Chloe has genetic heart disease and what's worse, due to her diligent teaching for years, the doctor believes that she could only live for

programme.title: Komada - A Whisky Family / 歡迎來到駒田蒸餾所
programme.desc: Kotaro, a novice editor for a web news, visits Komada Distillery for a project on Japanese craft whisky. Led by a young female president Rui who recently took over the family business, the distillery works hard to reproduce its signature whisky KOMA they had to stop making years ago. KOMA was a brand that Rui's family had lovingly preserved over generations and a symbol of happiness for all. However, not to mention financial backing, too many clues are missing to revive the whisky once lost. Rui, Kotaro, and the distillery supporters pull together every thread to bring back the whisky filled with family memories.

programme.title: Triangle / 鐵三角
programme.desc: Life has not been kind to Sam, Fai and Mok as they struggle to make ends meet. Routine visits to bars seem to be their only way out of miseries. Until a stormy evening when a mysterious old man appears before them with a tip: An ancient treasure is buried under the high-security Legislative Building. All they have to do is sneak in and retrieve it; if they believe in his story. Sam, Fai and Mok agree to make a run for the treasure to test their fate. What they uncover is beyond anything they expected: An ancient coffin containing a ceremonial robe made of gold...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E278 -Cold War 1994 / 爆谷電影現場 第278集 -寒戰 1994
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Dr. Coto's Clinic 2022 / 孤島診療所 2022
programme.desc: Shikina Island is a beautiful island located on the western edge of Japan. Kensuke Goto (Dr. Coto) came from Tokyo 19 years ago to this isolated island, 6 hours by ferry from the mainland. Since then, he has been the only doctor on the island and has borne the responsibility for the lives of all its residents. Over the years, the islanders have come to trust Coto, and Coto has come to trust them. He has become an irreplaceable presence and family member to all. A few years ago, he married Ayaka Hoshino, a nurse who has supported Coto for many years, and Ayaka is now seven months pregnant. Together with Ayaka's parents, Shoichi and Masayo, fisherman Gori Hara, former head fisherman Shigeo and his friends, Mariko, who runs a bar, and Wada, who helps out at the clinic, they live a peaceful life on the island. Now in 2022, Shikina Island, like many other rural areas in Japan, is experiencing depopulation and aging. Despite this somewhere in the back of their minds the islanders

programme.title: Smugglers / 閨密盜賞團
programme.desc: In 1970s South Korea, women free divers who have harvested shellfish suffer a threat to their livelihoods after a chemical factory opens in their seaside village. Using their specialty in diving and knowledge of the waters, old friends Choon-ja and Jin-sook start to smuggle goods. However, when they find out they are being set up, they plan for the most mind-bending and dangerous job to seek revenge, which could become their biggest break-or the end of it all.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E291 -Dust to Dust / 爆谷電影現場 第291集 -第八個嫌疑人
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: Fire of Conscience / 火龍
programme.desc: The investigation of a prostitute homicide brings headstrong, heavy-handed Detective Manfred in an unlikely collaboration with sly, man-of-the-world Inspector Kee from the Narcotics Bureau...

programme.title: Blue Giant / 藍色巨星
programme.desc: Miyamoto Dai, a student with a passion for basketball, has an overnight life-changing experience after going to a jazz show for the first time. As if hypnotised by this music he knows nothing about, the young man decides to devote himself heart and soul to the saxophone and jazz becomes his new passion. Will he succeed in becoming a great musician?

programme.title: Baogu Produces -The Frontline of Cold War / 爆谷製造 -寒戰前哨站
programme.desc: The long-awaited “Cold War” series returns! Director Longman Leung together with Terrance Lau and Louise Wong disclose the untold stories of filming “Cold War 1994”. While Terrance reveals filming car chase scenes had been his brush with death, Louise confesses to being stressed to play the role of a gang boss for the first time that took her three months of preparation for the action scenes. Longman also shares about the tycoon kidnapping case in the film inspired by real cases from the 1990s......

programme.title: Triumph in the Skies / 衝上雲霄
programme.desc: Young pilot Branson recently takes over Skylette, his father's aviation empire, only to realize his old flames Cassie is a flight attendant there. Several years ago, he was forced to break up with her and move to New York to take care of his father's business. To this day, the two continue to harbor feelings for each other but decide to keep them bottled up. In an effort to rebrand the airline, Branson invites rock idol TM to star in an upcoming commercial and appoints Sam as her flying consultant. Incongruent in both tastes and experience, this odd couple gets off on the wrong foot. As the shoot progresses, however, they slowly discover each other's merits, developing a strong mutual attraction. Jayden has left Skylette Airline to become a pilot for private jets. He meets the young and vivacious Kika during a flight and assumes her to be wayward and shallow. But they turn out to have a lot in common and start falling madly in love. At the height of their romance, Jayden real

programme.title: Alienoid: The Return to the Future / 祖宗膠戰外星人2
programme.desc: Ean has become trapped in the distant past while trying to prevent the escape of alien prisoners who are locked up in the bodies of humans. She eventually locates the Divine Blade, which can open a door through time, and sets off to find Thunder in order to return to the present. Meanwhile Muruk, who helps Ean escape various predicaments, is unnerved when he begins sensing the presence of a strange being in his body. Ean and Muruk are pursued by the so-called Sorcerers of Twin Peaks, Madam Black and Mr. Blue, who suspect that a monster lies within Muruk; by the warrior Nong-pa who hopes that the Divine Blade can restore his lost eyesight; and by the sinister Jajang who seeks the Blade for his own ends. Back in the present, the release of an alien substance haava by an escaped alien prisoner known as the Controller results in the death of thousands of people. Min Gaelin who witnesses this by chance comes to realize that this is only the beginning. With only 48 minutes left bef

programme.title: In Broad Daylight / 白日之下
programme.desc: If karma does not exist, would you still choose kindness? Based on true events, In Broad Daylight reveals a little-known truth about residential care homes for the disabled that hides beneath the headlines. A news organization's investigative journalism unit receives a tip about the abuse of residents in Rainbow Bridge Care Home. To expose the home's wrongdoings, reporter Kay goes undercover to expose the inhumanity inside, searching for the cruel truth under broad daylight.

programme.title: Director’s Premiere -Lawrence Kan / 初嚟報「導」 -簡君晋
programme.desc: 'In Broad Daylight', written and directed by emerging filmmaker Lawrence Kan, has garnered 16 nominations at the 42nd Hong Kong Film Awards. From the formative impact of films experienced in childhood to his adult pursuit of human connection through the lens of a camera, Lawrence's enduring curiosity about people has allowed him to witness the struggles of ordinary individuals-and, through a journey of being lost and learning to wait, to ultimately find his own voice. Let's follow this interview into Lawrence's inner world and listen to his pure passion and unwavering dedication to films.

programme.title: I Love Hong Kong 2012 / 2012我愛HK喜上加囍
programme.desc: The patriarch of the household, Kwok Ching is an experienced weather forecaster, who had been eyeing the post of news anchor for the longest time. But due to the oppression from his rival-turned-boss, Ching never had a promotion in his 20-year tenure. Kwok Mei-mei is the eldest of Ching's 3 children. A successful lawyer who specialized in divorce cases, Mei-mei is married to Yao Ming, a submissive husband who doubles as home-maker. Despite being married for years, the couple is still childless and that strains the already fragile relationship. Kwok Ching-ching, the tomboyish daughter of Ching is the second of his children. She and Lok Yi-ah, her effeminate colleague-turned-boyfriend had been discussing about getting married. Aaron Kwok is the youngest of the trio. The seemingly low-esteemed youth actually had this ambitious wish to win the heart of Vivian, a popular star who is rumored to be with tycoon, Roberto! While the daily squabbles within the family continue, Ching rec

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Vicious Men and Wicked Women / 爆谷製造 -狠男惡女
programme.desc: The cast of “We Are Born Good”, Yeung Wai Lun, Chung Suet Ying, and Kearen Pang, together with Director Yeung Leung Chuen, join us to discuss their lives as 'unconventional' individuals! In the interview, Suet Ying recalled that she was once harassed, prompting her to strike back by posting a public note; Wai Lun admitted that he used to fear the heavy responsibility of carrying a film as a lead actor; and Kearen shares how she once faced a 'curse' that made it difficult for her to land acting roles. Meanwhile, Leung Chuen offers warm encouragement, urging everyone to discover the small, beautiful things in life and regain their motivation! Tune in as the four of them personally unveil more surprising behind-the-scenes stories from the film.

programme.title: The Case - Continuous Homicide / 重案行動之連環兇殺
programme.desc: One night in Hong Kong, a clip of self-immolation began to go viral on the Internet. Before she died, the female deceased muttered words like she had hit an evil spirit. Then she picked up a lighter and lit it. Her whole body was on fire, and she screamed in pain. All the environmental evidence points to the teacher assisting others to commit suicide. The only thing is that he refused to admit murder, saying that he lost his memory...

programme.title: Coffin Homes / 鬼同你住
programme.desc: Three bizarre tales intertwine in this horror satire set against the housing crisis of Hong Kong, in which the soaring property prices have driven dwellers to take every insane effort necessary to secure a cramped space, even if it means sharing the same roof with the dead.

programme.title: “One Second” behind-the-scene documentary / 《一秒鐘》幕後紀錄片
programme.desc: “One Second” is the beautiful, moving and deeply personal homage to the redemptive power of cinema from Director Zhang Yimou. This documentary shows the behind-the-scene all the way from pre-production until the last shooting day of the film.

programme.title: Daughter's Daughter / 女兒的女兒
programme.desc: Now a widow in her sixties, Aixia must become a mother once more when she receives custody of her daughter's daughter – in the form of a fertilized embryo left by Aixia's daughter Zuer, who tragically died in a car accident. However, Aixia already has a second daughter: Emma, who Aixia abandoned as a teenager, and the shame over abandoning Emma has never faded.

programme.title: BL Metamorphosis / 春心萌動的老屋緣廊
programme.desc: Age is just a number when it comes to being a BL fan! 75-year-old widow Yuki (Nobuko Miyamoto) picks up a boys' love manga one day and it opens her eyes to a new world. At the bookstore, she meets shy 17-year-old schoolgirl Urara (Mana Ashida) who reads BL on the sly. Happily reading and discussing BL together, they forge a congenial bond that heals loneliness and unlocks their inner hopes and fears. Seasoned TV director Shunsuke Kariyama (Love's in Sight) and screenwriter Yoshikazu Okada (The 8-Year Engagement) adapt Kaori Tsurutani's award-winning manga into a heartwarming, female-centric human drama about an unlikely friendship that inspires comfort and change.

programme.title: Café Midnight: Missing Honey / 深夜咖啡屋：消失了愛人
programme.desc: Bride-to-be Yoon waits for her groom Tae-young on their wedding day but he doesn't show up. Out of concern and anger, she searches for him all day and in the dead of night, she arrives at a strange place called 'Cafe Midnight', which opens from midnight until the sun rises. Upon entering Yoon finally finds Tae-young, but something doesn't seem right. He looks a few years younger and he doesn't even recognize her. As past, present and future merge, will the bride find her groom?

programme.title: i'm livin' it / 麥路人
programme.desc: Once a star in his finance firm, Bowen now spends his nights in a 24-hour fast food joint, where he encounters others “roommates” who are in a similar predicament: a mother with her daughter who has taken out high-interest loans to cover her mother-in-law's debt, an old man who is too afraid to go home, a young runaway, a young singer living in a temporary shelter. Together these accidental roommates must strive to lift one another out of rock bottom.

programme.title: Love The Way You Are / 我的青春都是你
programme.desc: It's a romantic comedy between the next door neighbors Lin-lin Chou and Yu-ke Fang, who have totally opposite school performances. While Lin-lin struggles to pass the exams, Yu-ke gets the highest score in every of them. Just when Lin-lin supposes she is finally going to say good-bye to Yu-ke after high school graduation, they get accepted by the same department – department of animal husbandry, the most unpopular department of the most popular university. To fix Yu-ke's “First love trauma” she accidentally caused, Lin-lin tries everything to help him chase back his first love, the queen bee of the school. However, Lin-lin herself also gradually falls for Yu-ke during the process. What should Lin-lin do with her feelings? What is actually going on in Yu-ke's mind? The graduation season is around the corner, this is a story for you to call back your first love memory.

programme.title: Baogu Produces -Vicious Men and Wicked Women / 爆谷製造 -狠男惡女
programme.desc: The cast of “We Are Born Good”, Yeung Wai Lun, Chung Suet Ying, and Kearen Pang, together with Director Yeung Leung Chuen, join us to discuss their lives as 'unconventional' individuals! In the interview, Suet Ying recalled that she was once harassed, prompting her to strike back by posting a public note; Wai Lun admitted that he used to fear the heavy responsibility of carrying a film as a lead actor; and Kearen shares how she once faced a 'curse' that made it difficult for her to land acting roles. Meanwhile, Leung Chuen offers warm encouragement, urging everyone to discover the small, beautiful things in life and regain their motivation! Tune in as the four of them personally unveil more surprising behind-the-scenes stories from the film.

programme.title: New Dimension! Crayon Shinchan the Movie: Battle of Supernatural Powers ~Flying Sushi~ / 新次元！蠟筆小新大電影：超能力大決戰～飛吧飛吧手捲壽司～
programme.desc: 40-years ago, there was a prophecy claiming that in the year of “20” and “23”, two emitting lights would come to the Earth from outer space. And the dark light with strong power will bring out a huge disaster. In the summer of 2023, as predicted, two mysterious lights approach Japan and descend on Kasukabe. The white light hits Shin-chan, which makes him get a superpower. Meanwhile, a man called Mitsuru Hiriya, has been bathed in dark light and has acquired psychic powers begins to run amok. A man who wants the destruction of the world, Hiriya VS A happy-go-lucky kindergarten child, Shinnosuke. A superpower battle is going to begin!

programme.title: The Hill of Secrets / 秘密之丘
programme.desc: Sensitive 12-year-old Myung-eun (Moon Seung-a) is embarrassed of her working-class family and constantly lies to keep her true family situation a secret. When she writes, though, she is not constrained by reality. Pouring herself into essays, Myung-eun takes pride in constructing a different world of her own. However, the candid writings of a new student shake her sense of self, and prompt Myung-eun to better understand her family. Reminiscent of acclaimed coming-of-age Korean indies like The World of Us and House of Hummingbird, writer-director Lee Ji-eun's understated debut feature excels in its perceptive depiction of the emotions and experiences of a child trying to find her place in the world.

programme.title: Saving General Yang / 忠烈楊家將
programme.desc: The plot places focus on how the seven sons of the Yang family held hands in the rescue of their father. During a series of battles in a place called Jinsha, they pitted the few against the Khitans. Despite in great peril, they never lose faith or gave up their mission to save their father...

programme.title: Virus / 戀愛病毒
programme.desc: The world is under attack from an “Love virus”? Taek-seon is a translator who always feels tired, unmotivated and uninterested in romance. One day, Taek-seon has a disastrous blind date with Su-pil, a born single medical researcher who proposes on their first meeting. After the date they met, the world is suddenly enveloped in atmosphere of love... Taek-seon found herself laughing for no reason and searching for a beautiful dress, everything looks cute, even a daily promotional text from her old classmate Yeon-woo. However, Taek-seon knew that she had been infected with 100% fatality rate deadly virus -- Toxo Virus. She meets Dr. Lee Gyun, the only researcher who can create the antiviral medicine and she realizes that all these romantic feelings are symptoms of virus. Thus, her unexpected journey begins...

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E291 -Dust to Dust / 爆谷電影現場 第291集 -第八個嫌疑人
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: I Love Hong Kong / 我愛HK開心萬歲
programme.desc: Ng Shun returns with his wife Shun-Soh and three children to celebrate Ng Kin's 60th birthday. Unknown to Kin, his son has gotten into trouble and is plotting for him to take the rap. At the same time, Long, a swindler who conned money from the neighbours 30 years ago is now a property tycoon. He promises to pay each of the 30 neighbours HK$100 million as compensation as long as a representative of each household returns to the estate on Lunar New Year's Eve. A mad rush ensues as Shun and his family tries to gather the old neighbours to avoiding missing the bonanza.

programme.title: Baogu At the Movie E294 -Back to the Past / 爆谷電影現場 第294集 -尋秦記
programme.desc: Baogu At The Movie brings you the most exclusive behind the scenes of recent local blockbusters. The most true story and sincere conversation behind every piece of dreamwork.

programme.title: The Case - Limited Time Rescue / 重案行動之限時拯救
programme.desc: Police Force - Commercial Crime Bureau has been investigating Jufeng's finance for many years, but all failed due to insufficient evidence. In order to collect evidence, the Commercial Crime Bureau sent an informant to Jufeng. But when the informant successfully entered Jufeng Computer and stole the account, the immediate supervisor Sir Ren died mysteriously. Sir Chong started to take over the case...

programme.title: Rob N Roll / 臨時劫案
programme.desc: Two perplexed middle-aged losers, Robby and Fai are good friends. Fai is honest man. His wife left him with an elderly home business. Fai has tried very hard to keep it running until the owner increases the rent crustily. Taxi driver Robby, who is timid and unreliable, he always neglected the conflicts between his mother and his wife. Robby always lives paycheck to paycheck without a financial plan, so he is at a loss what to do. There are two robberies involving the money exchange stores just across the street encourages Robby and Fai to get a gun and rob the same. It is a destiny to meet the ruthless bandit Mui, who acts wicked, scheming and chivalrous.

programme.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time / 穿越時空的少女
programme.desc: Something strange has happened to Makoto Konno. Time has suddenly stopped and moved her backwards. With her newly discovered ability to literally leap backwards in time Makoto finds that tests become a piece of cake, embarrassing situations are corrected and she can have her favorite food anytime she wants. Unfortunately her carefree time traveling has adverse effects on the people she cares for. With every successful leap Makoto somehow alters the fate of those around her.
