programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E10 -Vietnam: the Journey's End / 野性湄公河 第10集 - 越南：旅途的終點
programme.desc: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs S1E2 -The Lifesavers / 狗建奇工 第2集 - 救生員小隊
programme.desc: Meet a border collie that protects aircraft from lethal bird strikes, a sprocker spaniel whose sense of smell is saving imperilled water voles, and an Anatolian shepherd that helps conserve Africa’s most endangered big cat, the cheetah.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs S1E3 -The Partners / 狗建奇工 第3集 - 搭檔
programme.desc: Meet a golden retriever that assuages anxiety and helps heal PTSD, a shepherd mix who rescues mudslide survivors, a pair of spaniels who sniff out underground water leaks, and a group of teacher’s pets in the UK that assist children learning to read.

programme.title: Shadowlands S1E3 -Age of Independence / 南荒之地 第3集 - 獨立紀元
programme.desc: The south-eastern coast of New Zealand are some of the richest fishing grounds in the world – the place for young marine animals to transition from novices to independent adults. Young whales, dolphins and seals learn to hunt, learn the rules of society, or strike out on their own adventures.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti S1E1 -First Steps / 成為大象：瑞提提的孤兒們 第1集 - 初踏之路
programme.desc: Explore community-run Reteti Elephant Sanctuary, where human surrogate moms offer survival lessons and nurture young elephants through play. Bond with trunkless Long’uro and see why six-year-old Kelele’s mysterious illness could delay his release.

programme.title: Becoming Elephant: the Orphans of Reteti S1E2 -Back to the Wild / 成為大象：瑞提提的孤兒們 第2集 - 重返野外
programme.desc: Balance the pain of goodbyes with hope for the future as a generation of rescued elephants are finally released. Welcome new additions to the Reteti family, including a baby elephant rescued from a watering hole and a traumatized zebra named Kisima.

programme.title: Strange Creatures S2E3 -Ocean Oddballs / 怪奇「物」語 第3集 - 海洋奇譚
programme.desc: Dive into the lives of the ocean’s weirdest animals. Looking into a whitemargin stargazer fish’s eyes can be a shocking experience (literally), while predators hoping to take down a peacock mantis shrimp will be stopped by its vice-like claws.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Kingdoms S1E4 -Namaqualand: the Desert Bloom / 非洲隱世國度 第4集 - 納馬夸：沙漠之花
programme.desc: For most of the year it’s a desert, but during early August and September the dusty valleys of Namaqualand transform into a wonderland carpeted with wildflowers. Witness this magnificent transformation from arid desert to beautiful oasis.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets S2E1 -Rhythm of the Bay / 極地奧秘 第1集 - 海灣的節奏
programme.desc: The Hudson Bay lowlands are part of North America’s largest wetland. Over 300,000 square kilometers of muskeg, a vast bogland as far as the eye can see characterized by water soaked peat, mosses and stunted trees. Once thought of as barren wasteland, it is now understood that these bogs are crucially important to life on earth. Globally, there is as much carbon dioxide held in wetlands as there is in the atmosphere. The peatland ecosystem is the most efficient carbon sink on the planet.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets S2E2 -Yukon Wild / 極地奧秘 第2集 - 育空之野
programme.desc: The Yukon is a true wilderness, one of the last on Earth. The vast land got its name from its longest river, which the Gwich’in, one of the indigenous people of the region, call 'Yu-kun- ah', or, the 'great river'. The third longest waterway in North America, the Yukon River flows through wide open valleys and narrow channels over 3,000 km Northwest towards the storm tossed Bering Sea.

programme.title: Arctic Secrets S2E3 -Waiting for Winter / 極地奧秘 第3集 - 等待冬天
programme.desc: It’s November at Cape Tatnam. Winter is coming to the lower Western shore of Hudson Bay. But the ice - which should be forming on Hudson Bay by now - is nowhere to be seen. 2016 has been the warmest year on record. In late November, the temperature is 10 degrees warmer than its average. Climate change is wreaking havoc across the North. At just below zero degrees Celsius, the sea cannot freeze.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia S1E1 -Tropical Shores / 深入澳大利亞 第1集 - 熱帶海岸
programme.desc: Explore the shores of the Northern Territory and the abundant waters of the Great Barrier Reef. Face flooded roads, hungry saltwater crocs, and killer jellyfish as Lizzie investigates why so many strange, deadly creatures make this remote area home.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia S1E2 -The Cool South / 深入澳大利亞 第2集 - 冷水南岸
programme.desc: Say goodbye to the tropics and dip into cool southern-coast waters. Come face to face with majestic grey nurse sharks, shape-shifting cuttlefish, and huge blue whales; play with penguins and sea lions; and learn why these seas are brimming with life.

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia S1E3 -The Wild West / 深入澳大利亞 第3集 - 狂野西澳
programme.desc: Complete the trip’s final lap in the untamed lands where Australia’s interior desert meets the hot, hostile Indian Ocean. Confront the challenges of survival in this region as Lizzie dives with tiger sharks, manta rays, and nomadic turtles.

programme.title: Wildlife ER S3E6 -End of Summer / 野生動物急診室 第6集 - 夏日終結
programme.desc: Follow vet Tim as he races to save rescued koala Ashley, then meet a flying fox with an extra digit who needs some TLC from vet Martine. Calculate the odds for a run-over kangaroo joey with vet Emily, then celebrate the release of 50 lorikeets.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia S1E1 -The Little Penguin / 澳洲野鳥 第1集 - 小藍企鵝
programme.desc: Follow the story of Harry and Sally, a pair of little penguins. These flightless, flippered birds create some of the noisiest neighborhoods in nature. Theirs is a family saga of faithful relationships, committed homemaking, and vigorous nightlife.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia S1E2 -Secret Life of the Emu / 澳洲野鳥 第2集 - 鴯鶓的奧祕
programme.desc: The Emu is Australia’s biggest native bird and is the second largest bird in the world after the African ostrich: two meters tall, with an almost three metre running stride and totally flightless. This bird inhabits a topsy turvy world, where females call the shots, eggs are green and men do all the work to produce and raise tiny babies, known as Stripeys.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia S1E3 -Aerial Hunters / 澳洲野鳥 第3集 - 空中獵人
programme.desc: Australia’s birds of prey are some of the region's fiercest predators. These highly specialised killers are powerful, resourceful and striking; they use some impressive weapons to survive. This is the story of Australia’s aerial hunters.

programme.title: Wild Birds of Australia S1E4 -The Feathering Nest / 澳洲野鳥 第4集 - 鳥巢
programme.desc: Successful breeding is critical to the survival of any bird species, and in this episode we meet four species of birds which go to exceptional lengths to find mates and raise their young, giving the next generation the best chance of life. Wherever they live, these birds have got their work cut out, holding their territory against invaders, attracting and winning partners and safeguarding their chicks.

programme.title: Wild Sky S1E4 -South America / 狂野天空 第4集 - 南美洲
programme.desc: Learn how South America’s rich diversity of weather fuels an even richer diversity of life. Examine the Amazon rainforest’s oxygen-breathing trees, follow the arc of a vast cloud river, and meet flamingos that thrive in the sun’s scorching UV rays.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E1 -Dining By Moonlight / 月球野性面 第1集 - 月下晚餐
programme.desc: Explore how lunar phases set the rhythm for an endless contest between predator and prey. Soar by moonlight with colugos, gorge on a shellfish feast with macaques, and watch a prowling pride of lions try to turn a baby elephant into dinner.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E2 -Moonlit Romance / 月球野性面 第2集 - 月光情緣
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E3 -Guided By the Moon / 月球野性面 第3集 - 月光指引
programme.desc: Set out on epic journeys guided by lunar forces. See how invisible signals guide whales and turtles along ocean migration routes, criss-cross continents with nightjar birds, and observe dung beetles and other insects that navigate by moonlight.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E4 -Chimpanzee / 野獸絕地求生記 第4集 - 黑猩猩
programme.desc: Track chimpanzees through the Rwandan forest with Max, who tries to convince these powerful monkeys that he’s a friend, not a foe. Pick up some key tips on jungle dining and witness complex family dynamics, including grooming and socializing.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E5 -Sloth Bear / 野獸絕地求生記 第5集 - 懶熊的神秘世界
programme.desc: Peek inside the secret world of the fearless, often misunderstood sloth bear. Travel to Sri Lanka with Max and discover how this fierce, shaggy animal fights off leopards and other deadly rivals, all while trying to secure enough protein to survive.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E6 -Leopard / 野獸絕地求生記 第6集 - 與豹同行
programme.desc: Prowl the Sri Lankan jungle with the leopard, who is a master of camouflage. See how this formidable feline hunter has adapted perfectly to the hot, dry climate on the island, then discover its best tricks for stalking and catching deer.

programme.title: Strange Creatures S2E4 -Anatomy Gone Wild / 怪奇「物」語 第4集 - 瘋狂的解剖學
programme.desc: Evolution has granted some animals a distinct advantage over their opponents. Investigate the perfect body-part mutations that have given wunderpus octopuses, axolotls, royal spoonbills, aye-ayes, and other creatures an edge.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Kingdoms S1E5 -De Hoop: Place of Hope / 非洲隱世國度 第5集 - 德胡普：希望之地
programme.desc: This small park makes a big difference to endangered animals. Offering sanctuary to some of the biggest and smallest animals on the planet, witness how species come back from the edge of extinction to reclaim their place in Africa’s wilderness.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends S1E1 -Born to Be Different / 動物朋友仔 第1集 - 生而不同
programme.desc: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a duck that won’t go in the water without a ride from her pooch pal, an elephant that thinks she’s a buffalo, and a herd of cows that adopt an orphaned deer.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends S1E2 -A Friend in Need / 動物朋友仔 第2集 - 患難見真情
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends including Charlotte, a schnauzer who enjoys bath time with her guinea pig pal Wallace, and a randy ram called Hamish who likes to sneak off to live with a herd of dairy cows instead of his own kind.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends S1E3 -The Young Ones / 動物朋友仔 第3集 - 年少朋友
programme.desc: In this episode of Amazing Animal Friends a rescued orphaned rhino befriended by a playful dog and doting sheep, a big bunny rabbit that babysits boisterous baby lambs, and a porcupine that helps two English bulldogs rehabilitate injured animals.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends S1E4 -Beast Buddies / 動物朋友仔 第4集 - 野獸好友
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, an animal shelter puppy that helps a captive cheetah cub get ready for the wild, and an injured monkey who wins over a pack of unfriendly dogs and a lonely mongoose that enjoys foraging with a flock of sheep.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends S1E5 -Creature Comforts / 動物朋友仔 第5集 - 知心陪伴
programme.desc: This episode of Amazing Animal Friends features a troop of rescue center monkeys that have adopted a litter of stray kittens, a loyal dog helping a rescued raccoon overcome her fears, and an emu raised by Irish setters.

programme.title: Amazing Animal Friends S1E6 -To the Rescue / 動物朋友仔 第6集 - 救命恩人
programme.desc: Meet more Amazing Animal Friends, including “ranch manager” Barclay, a Great Dane who happens to be a gifted horse whisperer. In Africa, a tiny marmoset called Thor has become obsessed with two young rescued mongooses.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E6 -Thailand: the River Basin / 野性湄公河 第6集 - 泰國：江河流域
programme.desc: From manicured rice fields to wild tropical rainforests, the Mekong River is the source of life for eastern Thailand. Watch gibbons negotiate family dynamics, and see how the pit viper creates danger for the region’s delicate living networks.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E7 -Cambodia: Hidden Refuges / 野性湄公河 第7集 - 柬埔寨：隱秘的庇護所
programme.desc: Bisected by the Mekong’s mighty waters, Cambodia is defined by its relationship to this great river. See why the country is a biodiversity hot spot and explore the secret refuges of animal populations that survive in its untouched natural habitats.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E8 -Cambodia: Seasonal Cycles / 野性湄公河 第8集 - 柬埔寨：季節週期
programme.desc: The Mekong is Cambodia’s lifeline, especially during the scorching dry season, when precious moisture is hard to come by. Learn how all manner of flying creatures, from birds to bats, manage resources until the rainy season brings sweet relief.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E9 -Vietnam: Life in the Delta / 野性湄公河 第9集 - 越南：三角洲的生活
programme.desc: The final country on the Mekong’s journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta. A large deposit of rich nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region, the jewel of Vietnam’s crown, a biological treasure trove.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong S1E10 -Vietnam: the Journey's End / 野性湄公河 第10集 - 越南：旅途的終點
programme.desc: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels. These channels split and shape the coastline, creating unique habitats for a variety of animals.

programme.title: Humanlike: The Chimps of Fongoli S1E1 / 人性之猿：豐戈利黑猩猩 第1集
programme.desc: Join anthropologist Jill Pruetz and guide Dondo (Johnny) Kanté and watch evolution happen in real time. Meet the elusive chimps of Fongoli, Senegal, who use tools, interact with fire, and adapt to the human world as it collides with their own.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School S3E1 -Back to School / 明猩學園 第1集 - 一年容易又開學
programme.desc: Start a promising new term at the Orangutan Jungle School in Borneo. See newbie Bumi struggle to focus, track skittish Rumba’s first timid steps toward independence, and cheer on star student Valentino as he experiences a bumpy start to college.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School S3E2 -Class Reunion / 明猩學園 第2集 - 同儕再聚
programme.desc: Follow new graduate Beni, who gets an exciting introduction to jungle college alongside former classmates Sura, Meryl, and Wine. Check on new arrival Molly and join Dr. Nadine as she grades slowpoke Bumi and wild child Monita on their latest lessons.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School S3E3 -Hard Lessons / 明猩學園 第3集 - 冒險後的教訓
programme.desc: Shudder as food-obsessed Beni gets a dramatic, educational smackdown from the local dominant male, Petruk. See spoiled rich kid Spanser, a former illegal pet, try to tamp down his sweet tooth before roguish Bumi goes on a wild joyride with Greta.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School S3E4 -Outbreak Alert / 明猩學園 第4集 - 肆「瘧」危機
programme.desc: Race to contain a case of malaria brought in by orphaned infant Cesia, then assess surrogate mum Sri’s plan to help Bumi. See the positive influence of Daput, a wild orangutan mum, on the college females before a shocking thief raids the food store.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School S3E5 -Absent Friends / 明猩學園 第5集 - 缺席的友伴
programme.desc: Hunt for missing nursery-class orphan Lahei and see shy Rumba try her weak left hand in a nest-building session. Watch younger Delilah school Bumi in class, then find out if Beni and Valentino will make the grade and finally earn their freedom.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School S3E6 -Graduation Day / 明猩學園 第6集 - 畢業典禮
programme.desc: Congratulate the new Orangutan Jungle School graduates, who aren’t all spring chickens. Follow the convoy to the release site, where the team bids their friends a poignant farewell, then enjoy raucous celebrations as Molly and Bumi move up a grade.

programme.title: Strange Creatures S2E5 -Giant Creepy Crawlers / 怪奇「物」語 第5集 - 巨物爬蟲驚魂
programme.desc: Crawl along with some of the world’s fiercest insects. Watch as giant cockroaches build their immune systems to ensure long life. Then check out the toxic prowess of giant millipedes and the invisibility cloaks of giant prickly stick insects.

programme.title: Wild Science S1E5 -Hippo / 野性科學 第5集 - 河馬
programme.desc: Look inside the life of one of Africa’s most iconic but misunderstood megafauna: the hippopotamus. Get in the middle of a sparring match and see just how deadly a territorial male’s bite can be, then witness the miracle of their underwater births.

programme.title: Wild Science S1E6 -Caiman / 野性科學 第6集 - 美洲鱷
programme.desc: Understand how adaptability has helped the caiman, a beast as old as the dinosaurs, evolve to face the modern world. Watch butterflies feed on their tears, then marvel at the maternal devotion on display in their communal nurseries.

programme.title: Wild Side of the Moon S1E2 -Moonlit Romance / 月球野性面 第2集 - 月光情緣
programme.desc: Visit a world of romance and adventure under the stars. Fall in love with sage grouse mating dances, see a pair of arctic fox lovers reunite, float among spawning fish on a coral reef, and visit the moonlit breeding ponds of blacksmith tree frogs.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E5 -Deadly Rivals / 非洲獵人 第5集 - 致命對手
programme.desc: Enter the world of a wild dog pack whose bountiful hunting grounds are threatened when a clan of spotted hyenas moves in nearby. The vulnerable pups start to go hungry as the scavenging rivals steal their food and eventually raid their den.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E6 -Buffalo Showdown / 非洲獵人 第6集 - 水牛對決
programme.desc: To the lion, the buffalo is not only a satisfying dinner but also dangerous. Track a herd of 300 buffalo along with the Mwamba pride, who must act quickly and carefully if they are to take down their prey.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E1 -Earth / 地球演化實錄 第1集 - 地土探秘
programme.desc: Travel to the ends of the Earth, where a drama is unfolding in real time. Meet animals, from tiny butterflies to huge humpback whales, that are acting as sentinels, adapting their behaviour, and helping us unlock the riddles of our changing planet.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E1 -Chasing Freedom / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第1集 - 追逐自由
programme.desc: Witness veterinarian Dr. Amanda Salb save an elephant calf caught in a poacher’s snare, racing time to treat the wound. Back at the base, an orphaned baby baboon meets his new family. A monitor lizard and duiker are returned to freedom in the wild.

programme.title: Jaguar Journals S1E1 -Meet the Jaguars / 美洲豹日誌 第1集 - 首度登場
programme.desc: Head out into the Pantanal with Lizzie and the Onçafari team on the hunt for a missing dominant male jaguar. Monitor the battle between young hopefuls, like outsider Badalo, who want to usurp his power and win over Fera and the other local females.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E1 -Einstein Must Go! / 獅群的法則 第1集 - 愛因斯坦必須離開！
programme.desc: Get to know the Waterfront Pride: males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einstein’s defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E2 -Adapt Or Die / 獅群的法則 第2集 - 適者生存
programme.desc: Feel the heat when the pride tries to hunt down adequate food as drought conditions push them (and their prey) dangerously close to death. Watch Einstein adapt to solo life, then assess the damage after new mom Kalwezi fights for her cubs’ lives.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E3 -Hide and Seek / 獅群的法則 第3集 - 捉迷藏戲
programme.desc: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions’ camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E4 -Family Dynamics / 獅群的法則 第4集 - 家族脈動
programme.desc: Say hello to a season of plenty as flood waters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobe’s banks. Watch Keeza and her cub make a break for it while Caller and Tom Tom brawl with their enemies, then cheer when Einstein finally finds a mate.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E5 -Einstein Rules / 獅群的法則 第5集 - 愛因斯坦主宰
programme.desc: Come full circle as the dry season descends and the Waterfront Pride enjoys good hunting and renewed confidence in their territory. Then celebrate the success of former outsider Einstein, who gets down to business as the king of his very own pride.

programme.title: Pridelands: Wilderness Reborn / 驕傲之地：野地回春
programme.desc: An Australian family go on an adventure to restore an old hunting ranch in South Africa. Their goal is to rebuild the overgrown habitat, create an eco-tourism ranch, and allow the natural wildlife, including predators, to move back in.

programme.title: Strange Creatures S2E6 -Camouflage and Colouration / 怪奇「物」語 第6集 - 偽裝與色彩
programme.desc: Hiding in plain sight helps many insect, fish, and amphibian species survive. Learn the ins and outs of an array of animal invisibility techniques, such as warning and disruptive colouration, mimicry, and active camouflage.

programme.title: Africa's Hunters S3E5 -Deadly Rivals / 非洲獵人 第5集 - 致命對手

programme.title: Big Cat Country S1E2 -Strength in Sisterhood / 大貓國度 第2集 - 姊妹同心

programme.title: Big Cat Country S1E5 -Hollywoods Held Hostage / 大貓國度 第5集 - 被挾持的獅群
programme.desc: During the last few weeks of the dry season, the prides stick close to the only available water in the river. But in Luangwa, that proximity spells danger - especially when the scent of a hippo kill compels the Hollywoods to cross the river.

programme.title: Wildlife Icons S1E1 -Africa's Big Cats / 野生動物明星 第1集 - 非洲大貓
programme.desc: Though Africa’s three big cats—the lion, leopard, and cheetah—live side by side, each has evolved a specialised set of hunting strategies that keep them from colliding. Take an in-depth look at the lives and stories of these iconic apex predators.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains S1E1 -The Fickle River / 逐雨之途 第1集 - 善變之河
programme.desc: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains S1E2 -Blood and Dust / 逐雨之途 第2集 - 血與塵
programme.desc: Discover the clever way elephants dig wells, and see the relief that comes with a sudden river-filling downpour. Mourn cheetah Kuleta’s loss after lions kill one of her cubs, and get a front-row seat when wild dog Phoenix faces off with a hyena mob.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains S1E3 -Praying for Rain / 逐雨之途 第3集 - 祈雨
programme.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenix’s search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride S2E3 -The Missing Manzi / 非洲野狗：族群對獅群 第3集 - 消失的曼齊成員
programme.desc: Join Julz and park scout Simon Chulu as they track the Kakuli pack, who they filmed last year, and a Manzi faction who’ve ditched a tracking collar and broken away from the group. Spot the Kakumbi making a kill before a happy Manzi reunion ensues.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs S1E4 -The Protectors / 狗建奇工 第4集 - 保衛者
programme.desc: A blind woman has found a new lease on life thanks to her canine running mate, a Jack Russell works as a super-nanny to a surprising array of species, and a team of dogs in Kenya are on daily patrol protecting endangered rhinos from poachers.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs S1E5 -The Scent Detectives / 狗建奇工 第5集 - 氣味偵探
programme.desc: A Labrador cross and its partner help prevent ecological disaster in Canada, a Lagotto Romagnolo unearths a rare delicacy in Washington forests, and a Belgian malinois team tracks down the critically endangered geometric tortoise to save the species.

programme.title: Survival of the Beast S1E6 -Leopard / 野獸絕地求生記 第6集 - 與豹同行
programme.desc: Prowl the Sri Lankan jungle with the leopard, who is a master of camouflage. See how this formidable feline hunter has adapted perfectly to the hot, dry climate on the island, then discover its best tricks for stalking and catching deer.

programme.title: Wild Science S1E5 -Hippo / 野性科學 第5集 - 河馬
programme.desc: Look inside the life of one of Africa’s most iconic but misunderstood megafauna: the hippopotamus. Get in the middle of a sparring match and see just how deadly a territorial male’s bite can be, then witness the miracle of their underwater births.

programme.title: Wild Science S1E6 -Caiman / 野性科學 第6集 - 美洲鱷
programme.desc: Understand how adaptability has helped the caiman, a beast as old as the dinosaurs, evolve to face the modern world. Watch butterflies feed on their tears, then marvel at the maternal devotion on display in their communal nurseries.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E5 -Grasslands / 地球演化實錄 第5集 - 草原奧祕
programme.desc: Explore one of Earth’s most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue S1E5 -Creatures Great and Small / 馬拉威野生拯救隊 第5集 - 不分大小
programme.desc: See Amanda and Sophie push boundaries to get a vervet monkey with a broken leg back into the wild, the team is challenged when collaring a four-ton elephant. Alma receives an orphaned, cat-like genet and an antisocial baboon rejoins a troop.

programme.title: Dogs with Extraordinary Jobs S1E4 -The Protectors / 狗建奇工 第4集 - 保衛者
programme.desc: A blind woman has found a new lease on life thanks to her canine running mate, a Jack Russell works as a super-nanny to a surprising array of species, and a team of dogs in Kenya are on daily patrol protecting endangered rhinos from poachers.

programme.desc: A Labrador cross and its partner help prevent ecological disaster in Canada, a Lagotto Romagnolo unearths a rare delicacy in Washington forests, and a Belgian malinois team tracks down the critically endangered geometric tortoise to save the species.

programme.title: Orangutan Jungle School S3E6 -Graduation Day / 明猩學園 第6集 - 畢業典禮
programme.desc: Congratulate the new Orangutan Jungle School graduates, who aren’t all spring chickens. Follow the convoy to the release site, where the team bids their friends a poignant farewell, then enjoy raucous celebrations as Molly and Bumi move up a grade.

programme.title: Wild Science S1E5 -Hippo / 野性科學 第5集 - 河馬
programme.desc: Look inside the life of one of Africa’s most iconic but misunderstood megafauna: the hippopotamus. Get in the middle of a sparring match and see just how deadly a territorial male’s bite can be, then witness the miracle of their underwater births.

programme.title: Jaguar Journals S1E5 -Badalo is Missing / 美洲豹日誌 第5集 - 巴達羅失蹤記
programme.desc: Watch the Onçafari team get to know Aroeira, their newly collared female, and take a peek at Aurora’s cub, Apolo. Continue to track Badalo, who has moved deeper into the flooded forest, where he puts Lizzie’s game-changing research in jeopardy.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S1E2 -Chinga the Lion Cub / 野小子 第2集 - 幼獅青加
programme.desc: In South Africa’s Greater Kruger Park, A little cub called Chiga has been born into family of hunters - the Mala Mala lion pride. Under the guidance of a devoted father, a fierce mother, and a playful sister, Chiga finds her place in the pride.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S1E3 -Usana the Cheetah Cub / 野小子 第3集 - 小獵豹烏珊娜
programme.desc: Usana, a cheetah cub is born with the odds stacked against her. Few cheetah cubs make it through their first year. Lucky for her, she’s got an amazing mother who will stop at nothing to keep her cubs safe. Usana might just follow in her footsteps.

programme.title: New Kids in the Wild S2E1 -Frida the Jaguar Cub / 野小子 第1集 - 美洲虎幼崽弗里達
programme.desc: Test limits with jaguar cub Frida, who’s honing her survival skills in Brazil’s Caiman Lodge Reserve. Learn how to sneak with mum Gatuna, see sister Anouk help her hide from hungry interlopers, and go on a reckless solo trek that takes a lucky turn.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World S1E1 -Summer Cubs / 大貓小世界 第1集 - 夏日幼獅
programme.desc: Welcome spring on the Gomoti River, where cheetah mum Phefo and lion mum Tshaba teach their cubs survival skills and keep them out of the jaws of the big male cats. See lion king Molelo go into battle while leopard Senatia tries to ensure his legacy.

programme.title: Big Cats, Small World S1E2 -Surviving the Flood / 大貓小世界 第2集 - 洪水倖存記
programme.desc: Track Molelo's pride, who are exhausted by cub care when the winter floods arrive. Check on the cheetah cubs, who make a difficult decision, and witness a scary encounter that makes leopard mum Sephiri choose between her old family and her new cubs.

programme.title: Wild Science S1E1 -Lion / 野性科學 第1集 - 獅子
programme.desc: Trace the lion’s rise from prehistoric predator to modern ruler as science reveals the battles, bonds, and brutal survival strategies that have shaped this iconic African hunter. Get swept up in the drama of lion society and high-risk hunts.

programme.title: Wild Dogs: Pack vs. Pride S2E4 -Kakumbi Are Vulnerable / 非洲野狗：族群對獅群 第4集 - 脆弱的卡昆比
programme.desc: Encounter an elephant as Julz and Henry from the ZCP track the Kakumbi pups, who face off with a stubborn, razor-tusked warthog. Follow Thandie Mweetwa, ZCP’s lion specialist, who counts the prides that are pushing the Manzi out of their territory.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Kingdoms S1E6 -Kogelberg / 非洲隱世國度 第6集 - 卡格堡
programme.desc: Considered to be the most beautiful of the Cape’s protected areas, Kogelberg Nature Reserve has experienced minimal human interference. Discover the spectacular land and sea life flourishing in this unique botanical wonderland.

programme.title: Animals Like Us S1E1 -A Penguin Proposal / 「擬人」動物 第1集 - 企鵝求婚記
programme.desc: Watch an Antarctic gentoo penguin pop the question with a rocky token of his devotion, then learn how a Madagascar lemur uses toxic millipedes for pest control. Bone up on makeup techniques with a flamingo and meet a honey badger that can pick locks.

programme.title: Animals Like Us S1E2 -House Hunting Hermit Crabs / 「擬人」動物 第2集 - 寄居蟹．找個家
programme.desc: Get in line with hermit crabs for an orderly shell exchange on a Belize beach, then meet a Senegalese chimp’s pet genet. Float with an otter who swaps hostages for free meals and admire the agricultural prowess of leafcutter ants in the rainforest.

programme.title: Animals Like Us S1E3 -Meerkat Survival School / 「擬人」動物 第3集 - 狐獴求生學校
programme.desc: Learn how to disarm and dine on scorpions with meerkat pups in the Kalahari Desert and review a lioness’ flirting strategy in Kenya. Meet same-sex penguin couples who are raising chicks together, then sign up for an Asian elephant babysitters’ club.

programme.title: Animals Like Us S1E4 -Pirate Birds / 「擬人」動物 第4集 - 偷食鳥
programme.desc: Go rogue with frigate birds, who steal meals from smaller seabirds; relax in a mongoose-run spa with a grateful warthog; and decode an African elephant’s secret message. Then watch lovelorn capuchin monkeys hurl rocks to attract prospective mates.

programme.title: Animals Like Us S1E5 -Lion Daycare / 「擬人」動物 第5集 - 獅子育兒中心
programme.desc: Discover why it takes a village to raise lion cubs in Kenya and sniff out the mating strategy of fragrant lemurs in Madagascar. Cut a rug at a honeybee dance party, then listen up as a forked-tailed drongo tricks other birds out of their dinner.

programme.title: Animals Like Us S1E6 -Shark Dentist / 「擬人」動物 第6集 - 鯊魚牙醫
programme.desc: Marvel at the toothy fish that help sharks maintain their pearly whites and discover the signature calls of dolphin families. Examine capuchin monkey’s nut-cracking stone tools, get the warm fuzzies when giraffes snuggle, and meet a meerkat mobster.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E1 -Earth / 地球演化實錄 第1集 - 地土探秘
programme.desc: Travel to the ends of the Earth, where a drama is unfolding in real time. Meet animals, from tiny butterflies to huge humpback whales, that are acting as sentinels, adapting their behaviour, and helping us unlock the riddles of our changing planet.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E2 -Islands / 地球演化實錄 第2集 - 多樣島嶼
programme.desc: Find out why islands are like mini-Earths where evolution happens before your eyes. Journey from the Galápagos to Antarctica to see how sea lions, finches, crickets, monkeys and other wildlife are finding surprising solutions to climatic problems.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E3 -Heat / 地球演化實錄 第3集 - 灼熱地球
programme.desc: Go to extremes, from the Sahara to the outback, where animals are teaching us how to survive in our heating world. Shelter in caves with chimps, see camels sip salt water, and listen as zebra finches sing to their eggs to make their chicks smaller.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E4 -Ice / 地球演化實錄 第4集 - 冰海之間
programme.desc: Trek to the planet’s quickly melting poles, where animals are giving scientists clues about our future existence. Learn how the movements of polar bears, penguins, and other arctic creatures could help humans map (and prevent) global warming.

programme.title: Evolution Earth S1E5 -Grasslands / 地球演化實錄 第5集 - 草原奧祕
programme.desc: Explore one of Earth’s most vital but overlooked habitats and learn how grasslands could slow climate change by soaking up more carbon than forests do. Meet key species, such as bison and pumas, that could restore this resource and heal our planet.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E4 -Family Dynamics / 獅群的法則 第4集 - 家族脈動
programme.desc: Say hello to a season of plenty as flood waters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobe’s banks. Watch Keeza and her cub make a break for it while Caller and Tom Tom brawl with their enemies, then cheer when Einstein finally finds a mate.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E5 -Einstein Rules / 獅群的法則 第5集 - 愛因斯坦主宰
programme.desc: Come full circle as the dry season descends and the Waterfront Pride enjoys good hunting and renewed confidence in their territory. Then celebrate the success of former outsider Einstein, who gets down to business as the king of his very own pride.

programme.title: Pridelands: Wilderness Reborn / 驕傲之地：野地回春
programme.desc: An Australian family go on an adventure to restore an old hunting ranch in South Africa. Their goal is to rebuild the overgrown habitat, create an eco-tourism ranch, and allow the natural wildlife, including predators, to move back in.

programme.title: Big Cats: Nine Lives S1E1 -Lions / 大貓九命 第1集 - 獅子
programme.desc: Chart the lion’s nine stages of life, from defenseless cub to confident adult to aging exile. See how rivalry, hunger, and pride dynamics shape its life on the Serengeti, and witness the loyalty and cooperation that make this social cat unique.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E1 -Einstein Must Go! / 獅群的法則 第1集 - 愛因斯坦必須離開！
programme.desc: Get to know the Waterfront Pride: males Tom Tom and Caller, 8 lionesses, 10 youths, and Einstein, the grown cub who never left home. Watch Einstein’s defiance catch up with him when rivals from the Outsiders Pride make a play that seals his fate.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E2 -Adapt Or Die / 獅群的法則 第2集 - 適者生存
programme.desc: Feel the heat when the pride tries to hunt down adequate food as drought conditions push them (and their prey) dangerously close to death. Watch Einstein adapt to solo life, then assess the damage after new mom Kalwezi fights for her cubs’ lives.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E3 -Hide and Seek / 獅群的法則 第3集 - 捉迷藏戲
programme.desc: Contend with the challenges of the rainy season, which turns everything green and spoils the lions’ camouflage. Watch Einstein fail to make new connections and weigh the pros and cons when Keeza and her cub are kidnapped by rival male Mad-Eye Moody.

programme.title: Pride Rules S1E4 -Family Dynamics / 獅群的法則 第4集 - 家族脈動
programme.desc: Say hello to a season of plenty as flood waters recede and vast herds of prey return to the Chobe’s banks. Watch Keeza and her cub make a break for it while Caller and Tom Tom brawl with their enemies, then cheer when Einstein finally finds a mate.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E3 -Lions Pt 1 / Extreme Animal Transport 第3集 - Lions Pt 1
programme.desc: The Razgrad Lions. A pride of inbred lions has been rescued from an illegal zoo in Razgrad, Bulgaria by animal welfare charity Four Paws. Two of the lions are newborn cubs Terez and Masoud. With no vet equipped to raise lions in Bulgaria, Marina with no prior experience, has taken on the courageous role of raising the cubs. A third adult lion, Ivan-Asen, having grown up in a tiny enclosure in the same illegal zoo is in a critical condition and will need expert care for the rest of his life. As the cubs grow its time for Marina to say goodbye to her baby boys and place them into FELIDA Big Cat Rescue Centre in the Netherlands, over 2000kms away. They will make the journey by road crossing borders into Romania, Hungry, Austria, Germany and finally the Netherlands. However, political tensions erupt when government Officials stall on the paperwork required to allow the lions to leave Bulgaria. programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E4 -Lions Pt 2 / Extreme Animal Transport 第4集 - Lions Pt 2
programme.desc: Locked in a dark cell in an illegal zoo is an adult lion who became known as Ivan -Asen. A result of generations of inbreeding at Razgrad Zoo, Bulgaria, he’s in extremely bad condition, with skeletal deformations as a result of growing up with no room to move. He was rescued by animal welfare organization, Four Paws and has been rehabilitating in Sofia Zoo. It’s a temporary holding facility while Four Paws find a long-term sanctuary equipped to care for a lion in his condition as he will need specialized care and pain medication for the time that he lives.He’s about to make the journey to his forever home. After weeks of crate training the veterinarians who specialize in large animal transports Marc and Juno are relieved that Ivan- Asen doesn’t need to be tranquilized to be moved into the crate. programme.title: River Hunters S1E7 -Durham - Henry VIII / River Hunters 第7集 - Durham - Henry VIII
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette take on the stunning River Wear - a natural fortress protecting the ancient city of Durham and its sacred Cathedral. This is where in the 1500’s, Henry VIII seized power of the Church and the Cathedral’s shrines were plundered. Now Rick and Beau, joined by Durham’s diving archeologist Gary Bankhead, are hunting for hidden treasures to uncover evidence of what life was like from this majestic city’s turbulent past.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E3 -Lions Pt 1 / Extreme Animal Transport 第3集 - Lions Pt 1
programme.desc: The Razgrad Lions. A pride of inbred lions has been rescued from an illegal zoo in Razgrad, Bulgaria by animal welfare charity Four Paws. Two of the lions are newborn cubs Terez and Masoud. With no vet equipped to raise lions in Bulgaria, Marina with no prior experience, has taken on the courageous role of raising the cubs. A third adult lion, Ivan-Asen, having grown up in a tiny enclosure in the same illegal zoo is in a critical condition and will need expert care for the rest of his life. As the cubs grow its time for Marina to say goodbye to her baby boys and place them into FELIDA Big Cat Rescue Centre in the Netherlands, over 2000kms away. They will make the journey by road crossing borders into Romania, Hungry, Austria, Germany and finally the Netherlands. However, political tensions erupt when government Officials stall on the paperwork required to allow the lions to leave Bulgaria. Moving the national animal of Bulgaria across international borders is something powers high up a

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E4 -Lions Pt 2 / Extreme Animal Transport 第4集 - Lions Pt 2
programme.desc: Locked in a dark cell in an illegal zoo is an adult lion who became known as Ivan -Asen. A result of generations of inbreeding at Razgrad Zoo, Bulgaria, he’s in extremely bad condition, with skeletal deformations as a result of growing up with no room to move. He was rescued by animal welfare organization, Four Paws and has been rehabilitating in Sofia Zoo. It’s a temporary holding facility while Four Paws find a long-term sanctuary equipped to care for a lion in his condition as he will need specialized care and pain medication for the time that he lives.He’s about to make the journey to his forever home. After weeks of crate training the veterinarians who specialize in large animal transports Marc and Juno are relieved that Ivan- Asen doesn’t need to be tranquilized to be moved into the crate. programme.title: Running Wild with Bear Grylls S2E9 -President Barrack Obama / Running Wild with Bear Grylls 第9集 - President Barrack Obama
programme.desc: President Barack Obama and Bear Grylls explore the Alaskan wilderness, where they observe evidence of climate change, sample wild salmon and catkins tea made with water from melting glaciers; Obama discusses his official duties, parenthood and faith.

programme.title: River Hunters S1E7 -Durham - Henry VIII / River Hunters 第7集 - Durham - Henry VIII
programme.desc: This time on River Hunters, presenter and wild swimming loving Rick Edwards - and real life river hunter Beau Ouimette take on the stunning River Wear - a natural fortress protecting the ancient city of Durham and its sacred Cathedral. This is where in the 1500’s, Henry VIII seized power of the Church and the Cathedral’s shrines were plundered. Now Rick and Beau, joined by Durham’s diving archeologist Gary Bankhead, are hunting for hidden treasures to uncover evidence of what life was like from this majestic city’s turbulent past.

programme.title: Experience Australia S1E5 -Queensland / Experience Australia 第5集 - Queensland
programme.desc: Known as ‘The Sunshine State,’ Queensland is a region of spectacular beauty and adventurous possibilities. programme.desc: From the ancient mountains of the Flinders Ranges to the rocky shores of the Great Australian Bight, South Australia is a land brimming with culture, history and natural wonders. programme.title: Feral S1E1 -Lionfish / Feral 第1集 - Lionfish
programme.desc: The white sand beaches and emerald green waters of Destin, Florida are the setting for the 'World's Luckiest Fishing Villages.' Beneath the water's surface, it's a different story...one of the most formidable species, the lionfish, has been wreaking havoc on the local ecosystem for decades. The ecological advantage of the lionfish is its venomous spikes, used to corner prey and protect itself from predators, and giving it an advantage over native fish. Luckily, local conservationists and fishing captains discovered years ago that lionfish are as tasty as they are dangerous. Yia joins local biologist Alex Fogg as he works to mitigate the lionfish's damage by harvesting them one buttery, flaky bite at a time.

programme.title: Feral S1E2 -Feral Hogs / 第2集 - Feral Hogs
programme.desc: The feral hog is one of the most formidable species on the planet. Possessing a unique combination of high reproductive capacity, size, and adaptability, the feral hog absolutely decimates entire ecosystems. With pork chops on his mind, Yia travels to the Florida/Alabama border to join Jennifer Bearden and Zack Franks who are doing their part to help control the rampant feral hog population menacing Florida.

programme.title: Feral S1E3 -Burmese Pythons / Feral 第3集 - Burmese Pythons
programme.desc: If you asked experts what the most prevalent predator species in the United States is, without hesitation, the answer would be the Burmese pythons in the Florida Everglades. Growing up to 26-feet long and weighing as much as 200 pounds, the Burmese python has completely altered the ecosystem of the Everglades by eliminating over 99% of the native mammal population. To save the 'Glades, the hunter has become the hunted as Dusty 'Wildman' Crum has made it his mission to eradicate this species. Luckily for Yia, python is considered a delicacy in many countries, and Dusty believes these constrictors should be restricted to life on a plate, which helps take a bite out of the problem.

programme.title: Feral S1E4 -Green Iguanas / Feral 第4集 - Green Iguanas
programme.desc: A once sought-after pet, the green iguanas escaped their terrariums in the 60's and found the Florida eco-system to be a much more hospitable environment to call home. Free to roam the canals, parks, and suburban neighborhoods, these pets-gone-feral have exploded in both size and population, causing hundreds of millions of dollars of damage a year in Florida. Urban hunter Michael Onega is doing his part to clean up the environment by removing as many iguanas as possible, limiting their population spread. The singular goal - to make sure the iguanas never establish a healthy breeding population in the Everglades. Yia joins Michael and his trusty Labrador Scout on Michael's mud boat, as they patrol the canals in Michael's backyard. The only thing better than Scout retrieving the fallen iguanas, are BBQed iguana and iguana tacos cooked up in Michael's backyard.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E1 -Polar Bear / Extreme Animal Transport 第1集 - Polar Bear
programme.desc: Henry is no ordinary polar bear. Born at Sea World on the Gold Coast, Australia, it was planned from day one that he would eventually make the journey to the small-town of Cochrane in Ontario, Canada, where he can live like a wild polar bear. The town folk of Cochrane decided they wanted the polar bear as its mascot, so they built an amazing polar bear facility. But there was one problem, they didn’t have a polar bear. Back at Sea World, Queensland, Henry is now an adult and after months of crate training and logistical planning, departure day arrives. The first leg is to Sydney but with no plane equipped to carry a polar bear, the Australian military step in. He flies first-class with his keepers on a Hercules jet to Sydney. From Sydney to Hong Kong, then Hong Kong to Vancouver where the plane is delayed, and Henry has eaten all his food. There’s still a long way to go to Ontario and they need to feed this hungry polar bear. It’s 11pm and there’s a supermarket close to the

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E2 -Tigers (Circus Tigers) / Extreme Animal Transport 第2集 - Tigers (Circus Tigers)
programme.desc: The prestigious Wonderland Circus has become the second Spanish circus to voluntarily end its show with wild animals. Seven tigers have been donated to animal rights organisation Animal Advocacy and Protection (AAP). It’s the largest rescue of big cats in Spain to date. The tigers are first transported temporarily to AAP’s specialized rescue centre, Primadomus in Spain for their rehabilitation process. Here they are trained to enter their crate voluntarily so as to avoid sedation for the long journey to the Isle of Wight in the UK. The team are well prepared. With no hotel equipped to accommodate five adult tigers, they must make the 30-hour road trip nonstop! The transport crosses cinematic landscapes, through the northern Spanish countryside, across the French border, through the Pyrenees and across the iconic Millau Viaduct, the longest cable-stayed bridge in the world that crosses over the Tarn River in the South of France. programme.title: Feral S1E1 -Lionfish / Feral 第1集 - Lionfish
programme.desc: The white sand beaches and emerald green waters of Destin, Florida are the setting for the 'World's Luckiest Fishing Villages.' Beneath the water's surface, it's a different story...one of the most formidable species, the lionfish, has been wreaking havoc on the local ecosystem for decades. The ecological advantage of the lionfish is its venomous spikes, used to corner prey and protect itself from predators, and giving it an advantage over native fish. Luckily, local conservationists and fishing captains discovered years ago that lionfish are as tasty as they are dangerous. Yia joins local biologist Alex Fogg as he works to mitigate the lionfish's damage by harvesting them one buttery, flaky bite at a time.

programme.title: Feral S1E2 -Feral Hogs / 第2集 - Feral Hogs
programme.desc: The feral hog is one of the most formidable species on the planet. Possessing a unique combination of high reproductive capacity, size, and adaptability, the feral hog absolutely decimates entire ecosystems. With pork chops on his mind, Yia travels to the Florida/Alabama border to join Jennifer Bearden and Zack Franks who are doing their part to help control the rampant feral hog population menacing Florida.

programme.title: Feral S1E3 -Burmese Pythons / Feral 第3集 - Burmese Pythons
programme.desc: If you asked experts what the most prevalent predator species in the United States is, without hesitation, the answer would be the Burmese pythons in the Florida Everglades. Growing up to 26-feet long and weighing as much as 200 pounds, the Burmese python has completely altered the ecosystem of the Everglades by eliminating over 99% of the native mammal population. To save the 'Glades, the hunter has become the hunted as Dusty 'Wildman' Crum has made it his mission to eradicate this species. Luckily for Yia, python is considered a delicacy in many countries, and Dusty believes these constrictors should be restricted to life on a plate, which helps take a bite out of the problem.

programme.title: Malaysian Wildlife S1E1 / Malaysian Wildlife 第1集
programme.desc:
Malaysia's rainforest is one of the most biodiverse in the world and one of the last habitats for wild tigers. The wild elephants of the forest are drawn to cultivated land. Conflicts between humans and animals are inevitable. No one wants to share the habitat with dangerous animals.
The Malaysian jungle is an ecosystem of great biodiversity. In the shelter of the forest wild elephants, tigers, tapirs, and a rich bird life can be found. But rapid deforestation is threatening the future of many species of wildlife. While willingness to protect the rainforest is growing as prosperity increases, nature and species protection conflicts with the need to improve living conditions for the rural population.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E5 -Rhino / Extreme Animal Transport 第5集 - Rhino
programme.desc: At 9 years of age Kifaru is already a well-travelled Southern White Rhino. He was born in New Zealand at Hamilton Zoo as part of their Rhino breeding programmed. Then in 2014, at five years of age, he was moved across the Tasman Sea to Australia to the National Zoo and Aquarium. After four years in the country’s capital zoo, it’s time for him to move again. This time, getting him into the transportation crate is not easy but the team are ready with plans A – Z.

programme.title: Extreme Animal Transport S1E6 -Elephants Pt1 African Elephants / Extreme Animal Transport 第6集 - Elephants Pt1 African Elephants
programme.desc: Derek Milburn runs NGO Elephants Rhinos and People, which, over the course of a year will transport 250 elephants from South Africa to Mozambique via road. The current location of the herd is getting overcrowded which could eventually be dangerous to both elephants and people in surrounding villages. This first mission will involve 25-30 elephants the number will vary depending on how many ERP’s team find in the herd. Day one of the mission and the trucks get stuck in mud before reaching the elephants. A helicopter flies above darting the herd with a tranquilizer. They must dart the females first, to ensure the rest of the herd stay, darting a male accidentally means the herd could split and be lost altogether. They must be careful not to leave one of the family behind, this would mean disaster for the abandoned animal. The elephants are then lifted upside down with a helicopter onto their crates. They cross two border checkpoints crossing into Swaziland and Mozambique. Derek has his p

programme.title: Feral S1E5 -Rusty Crayfish / Feral 第5集 - Rusty Crayfish
programme.desc: In the land of ten thousand lakes, Leech Lake stands out, because it's the third largest lake located entirely within the state of Minnesota. Known as a destination for walleye, pike and muskie fishing, Leech Lake attracts fishermen from all over the Midwest... and that's where the trouble began. Fishermen from the Ohio River Basin brought rusty crawfish up to Leech Lake as bait... and when done fishing, they released them, inadvertently giving the rusty crayfish a new home. Now, the rustys are pushing out the native crayfish, and destroying the weed beds the muskie, pike and walleye depend on. Fishing guide Phil Bauerly sees the destruction daily. To combat the rustys, Phil regularly throws lakeside crayfish boils for family and friends... and Yia just received his invitation to join.

programme.desc: Common carp are one of the most widely introduced species of fish in the world. However, most people in the U.S. won't eat them, referring to them as a 'trash fish.' Bowfisherman and fishing guide Curt Cich will tell you otherwise, as these fish are fun to bowhunt, have plenty of fresh meat and are delicious smoked. These fish are so plentiful, Curt runs a year-round full-time guiding service targeting only carp.

programme.title: Feral S1E5 -Rusty Crayfish / Feral 第5集 - Rusty Crayfish
programme.desc: In the land of ten thousand lakes, Leech Lake stands out, because it's the third largest lake located entirely within the state of Minnesota. Known as a destination for walleye, pike and muskie fishing, Leech Lake attracts fishermen from all over the Midwest... and that's where the trouble began. Fishermen from the Ohio River Basin brought rusty crawfish up to Leech Lake as bait... and when done fishing, they released them, inadvertently giving the rusty crayfish a new home. Now, the rustys are pushing out the native crayfish, and destroying the weed beds the muskie, pike and walleye depend on. Fishing guide Phil Bauerly sees the destruction daily. To combat the rustys, Phil regularly throws lakeside crayfish boils for family and friends... and Yia just received his invitation to join.

programme.title: Feral S1E6 -Common Carp / Feral 第6集 - Common Carp
programme.desc: Common carp are one of the most widely introduced species of fish in the world. However, most people in the U.S. won't eat them, referring to them as a 'trash fish.' Bowfisherman and fishing guide Curt Cich will tell you otherwise, as these fish are fun to bowhunt, have plenty of fresh meat and are delicious smoked. These fish are so plentiful, Curt runs a year-round full-time guiding service targeting only carp.

programme.title: Feral S1E7 -Chinese Mystery Snails / Feral 第7集 - Chinese Mystery Snails
programme.desc: In the crystal clear lakes of Northern Wisconsin lurks a peculiar creature... the Chinese Mystery Snail which gets its namesake from female snails giving birth to young, fully developed snails that suddenly and 'mysteriously' appear. Utilized for its high protein, low fat content in China, the mystery snail is a food source believed to aid in treatment of digestive disease. Eager to explore this feral snail as a food source, Yia travels to Clear Lake to meet up with Wisconsin Fisheries Specialist Titus Seilheimer, who's seen first hand the explosion of these snails at his family's lakefront resort.

programme.title: Feral S1E8 -Axis Deer / Feral 第8集 - Axis Deer
programme.desc: Yia travels to Texas to hunt arguably the tastiest of all deer. Native to India, the Axis deer were introduced in Texas in 1932 as a prized game meat for ranchers. The Texas hill country turned out to be the perfect habitat for Axis deer, who quickly escaped their high fence ranches, establishing a healthy wild breeding population. Now with over 150,000 Axis deer roaming the hill country, these deer are competing with native white tail deer for resources. Local rancher Chris Hughes has a solution- a mobile harvesting trailer where he culls wild Axis deer from overpopulated farms. Chris will show Yia how harvesting this species has become a full-time business and delicious solution.

programme.title: Malaysian Wildlife S1E1 / Malaysian Wildlife 第1集
programme.desc:
Malaysia's rainforest is one of the most biodiverse in the world and one of the last habitats for wild tigers. The wild elephants of the forest are drawn to cultivated land. Conflicts between humans and animals are inevitable. No one wants to share the habitat with dangerous animals.
The Malaysian jungle is an ecosystem of great biodiversity. In the shelter of the forest wild elephants, tigers, tapirs, and a rich bird life can be found. But rapid deforestation is threatening the future of many species of wildlife. While willingness to protect the rainforest is growing as prosperity increases, nature and species protection conflicts with the need to improve living conditions for the rural population.

Malaysia's rainforest is one of the most biodiverse in the world and one of the last habitats for wild tigers. The wild elephants of the forest are drawn to cultivated land. Conflicts between humans and animals are inevitable. No one wants to share the habitat with dangerous animals.
The Malaysian jungle is an ecosystem of great biodiversity. In the shelter of the forest wild elephants, tigers, tapirs, and a rich bird life can be found. As Tess navigates motives of revenge and business rivalry in a race against time to uncover the location of the soon-to-be murder victim and save his life, Sunny tricks Kye and obtains his security code, obsessively monitoring her neighbours on the building's CCTV cameras, convinced she witnessed a murder. As the girl's whole family comes under suspicion, Sunny brings some much needed perspective to the pressure put on many first generation kids by immigrant parents, helping Tess track the girl down in an unexpected location and uncover the dark truth behind her disappearance. The case prompts Tess to revisit a traumatic event in her childhood with Lucas and show support ahead of his wedding day.

programme.title: Sight Unseen S2E8 -Hindsight / 看不見的罪案 第8集 - Hindsight
programme.desc: A case comes to haunt Tess when a righteous lawyer challenges her testimony about a home invasion gone wrong, threatening to overturn the conviction and Tess's future with the force – all on the basis of her vision loss. When Bennett takes Tess off the case to contain a potential scandal, Tess finds an unexpected ally in Owen, but she and Sunny are left wondering about their future, and worse: did Tess put an innocent man in jail? Tess leans on Matt and Mia, while Sunny grows hilariously defensive with her new therapist.

programme.title: Passe-Moi Les Jumelles S11E8 -Tiny Creator / Passe-Moi Les Jumelles 第8集 - Tiny Creator
programme.desc: Hugo Lienhard is a model craftsman. After working on scenery for theatre and opera, today he makes impressive miniature archaeological reconstitutions for several museums in French-speaking Switzerland.

programme.title: Demo De Mode S1E5 -Imane Ayissi / Demo De Mode 第5集 - Imane Ayissi
programme.desc: For the spring-summer 2024 season, the designer Imane Ayissi presents 'Abeung Sanda Iye', a haute couture collection in which he explores fabric and the infinite ways it can be wrapped, draped and multi-layered.

programme.desc: For those who want to get ahead on weekly meals, Isabelle shares a special spaghetti sauce recipe, perfect for freezing.

programme.title: Generation F S1E20 -Souleymane Diamanka (Paris)/Farah Abidi (Paris) / Generation F 第20集 - Souleymane Diamanka (Paris)/Farah Abidi (Paris)
programme.desc: Richard Orlinski meets Souleymane Diamanka, a Franco-Senegalese poet and heir to the Peul tradition. A master of improvisation, he draws on his roots and the French language to create a vibrant contemporary poetry where each word is an explosion carrying memory and identity. With great boldness, Franco-Tunisian designer Farah Abidi combines haute couture and streetwear. She asserts an artistic vision in which her origins are expressed in XXL volumes, using noble materials, ancestral symbols and ethnic jewelry.

programme.title: Terre Nourriciere S2E1 -Birds And Man / Terre Nourriciere 第1集 - Birds And Man
programme.desc: Melanie meets master falconers to learn more about the relationship that has existed between birds of prey and man for over 4,000 years. She is taken on a small game hunt and learns about the challenges and culture of this practice.

programme.desc: A look at the sporting activities of the Ubaye Valley: ski-hok, which combines snowshoeing and skiing, and ski joering, skiing while being pulled by a horse. Also discover the streets of Barcelonnette and its luxurious Mexican-style villas.

programme.desc: Camille is a teacher, Guido an engineer at the EPFL and Lyell a high-flying performer. All three share a passion, the slackline, balancing on a line between two mountains. They talk about their fear of heights, the mastery of their mind and body, and surpassing themselves.

programme.title: L'art ET La Matiere S9E14 -Rare Knowhow In Normandy / L'art ET La Matiere 第14集 - Rare Knowhow In Normandy
programme.desc: At the Ateliers Saint-Cyr, in Normandy, art craftsmen innovate in weaving, bookbinding, and filography, showcasing a rare local expertise. Also, the story of the Tank watch by Cartier, created in 1917 and inspired by the tanks of the First World War.

programme.desc: In Liege, Nathalie lets herself be guided by the tramway. A stop at Le Jacadi and the Trinkhall Museum, places that highlight recycling and social connection. In the same spirit, Julien Lapraille discovers the Terra Alter project, which offers short supply chain vegetables for public institutions.

programme.title: L'epicerie:2026 E7 -Are All Pasta Products Created Equal? / L'epicerie 第7集 - Are All Pasta Products Created Equal?
programme.desc: All pasta products contain roughly the same ingredients, but what explains the differences in price? Are there really differences in quality?

programme.desc: A native of Val d'Herens, Marlene Mauris took over the La Sage grocery shop five years ago. She hopes to save this place, which is essential to an entire community.

programme.desc: Shanju is a school, workshops and a group. Cofounded by Judith Zagury, this ambitious project combines circus teaching and work with animals. With a single idea in mind, to give pride of place to the relationship with animals.

programme.title: Echappees Belles S19E32 -Quercy, History At The Heart / Echappees Belles 第32集 - Quercy, History At The Heart
programme.desc: Just an hour from Toulouse, Quercy, a former medieval province, stretches across more than 300,000 hectares of greenery. The promise of an immersive stay in the heart of nature. How does Quercy manage to preserve its rich natural and historical heritage in the face of modern challenges?

programme.title: Donner L'gout S1E4 -Vietnam In Montreal / Donner L'gout 第4集 - Vietnam In Montreal
programme.desc: Meeting Mitch and Boom, the duo behind La Belle Tonki, a Vietnamese restaurant in Montreal. Helene also discovers Anh, Mitch's mother, who shares with her the secrets of a good pho soup.

programme.desc: On the programme: Adeline Lefranc and the L'Enracineuse nursery; taro cultivation in French Polynesia; from Dinant to the sea, landscapes of the Rance; Don't panic with Flavie.

programme.title: Une Brique Dans Le Ventre:2025-2026 E6 -Extension Of A Character Home From The 1970S / Une Brique Dans Le Ventre 第6集 - Extension Of A Character Home From The 1970S
programme.desc: In the Genappe region, discover the renovation of a 1970s home set in the heart of nature, carried out while fully respecting the building's original architecture.

programme.title: Cosy, Le Mag Deco:2024 E8 -Nadine's Town House / Cosy, Le Mag Deco 第8集 - Nadine's Town House

programme.title: Batie Girl / 巴铁女孩
programme.desc: Lu You, a famous young Chinese female footballer, is struck by injury and that puts an end to her sports career. She is down into the dumps and comes to the droughty, poor and backward village in north Pakistan to escape from it, where she accidentally helps the little girls realize their football dreams and alters the course of the girls' miserable life - getting married at the age of 13. For Lu You, the kindness and innocence of the Pakistani girls gradually opens up her heart that's been long shut to the outside and revives her confidence to step up to life. In the end, new sources of water in the village are gotten through by the Chinese enterprises which offer assistance to the construction of Pakistan due to the effort of this Chinese girl, thus radically changing the predicament of poverty and backwardness here.

programme.title: Tales From Modern China / 你所不知道的中国（第三季） Ep5
programme.desc: Two British presenters travel across China, revealing the unique cultures, innovations, and communities that shape the nation's diverse regions.

programme.title: Lasting Aroma / 茶知道答案
programme.desc: A tea maker's journey to preserve rare Wuyi teas and traditional craftsmanship.

programme.title: Adoring / 宠爱
programme.desc: Pet center owner and vet Vivian provides medical care for all pets in the community; she witnesses six heart-warming stories among the pets and their owners. The six stories are interconnected with laughter and tears, until every family's problem is eventually resolved. The pets and their humans then live happily ever after.

programme.title: A Journey to South Xinjiang, China / 南疆纪行 Ep1

programme.title: Batie Girl / 巴铁女孩
programme.desc: Lu You, a famous young Chinese female footballer, is struck by injury and that puts an end to her sports career. She is down into the dumps and comes to the droughty, poor and backward village in north Pakistan to escape from it, where she accidentally helps the little girls realize their football dreams and alters the course of the girls' miserable life - getting married at the age of 13. For Lu You, the kindness and innocence of the Pakistani girls gradually opens up her heart that's been long shut to the outside and revives her confidence to step up to life. In the end, new sources of water in the village are gotten through by the Chinese enterprises which offer assistance to the construction of Pakistan due to the effort of this Chinese girl, thus radically changing the predicament of poverty and backwardness here.

programme.title: My Other Home / 我是马布里
programme.desc: The story is about former NBA superstar Stephon Marbury who brings his talent and his Championship dream to China, teaming up with a group of courageous young men, who dare to share his dream, and meeting a surprisingly open-minded coach, Zheng, whose unconditional trust gives Marbury the ultimate support he needs. Together they bring the team to the Finals, and eventually put up the most epic fight against China's best team, Guangdong, who is a seven-time-championship team and considered unbeatable.

programme.title: Patrolman Bao Yin / 片警宝音
programme.desc: Two women suddenly arrive in this quiet town, their respective names are Zora and Li Hong. Under the assistance of Bao Yin, Zora not only finds her long-lost father, but also discovers love and a sense of returning home. Li Hong has struggled to adapt to the pastoral life, however due to the direct and indirect help of Bao Yin she finally adapts to her new surroundings and falls in love with the land. However, just as Li Hong's life is improving, she is unfortunately killed by gangsters. Bao Yin finds himself once again in pursuit of a murder case that appears seemingly hopeless.

Li Hong has struggled to adapt to the pastoral life, however due to the direct and indirect help of Bao Yin she finally adapts to her new surroundings and falls in love with the land. programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Ep6
programme.desc: Although the Mekong runs down Thailand's far eastern border, the influence of the river's basin reaches across nearly half the country.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Ep7
programme.desc: Cambodia is a country that lies almost entirely within the Mekong basin, flanked by Thailand, Laos and Vietnam. The Mekong travels the length of the country entering in the north and tracking south.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Ep8
programme.desc: This episode follows the seasonal eb and flow of the Mekong through Cambodia - a nation where everything has a special relationship with water.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Ep9
programme.desc: The final country on the Mekong's journey is the home of the rivers mighty delta. A large deposit of nutrients carried downstream from hundreds of kilometres makes this region a biological treasure trove.

programme.title: Mysteries of the Mekong Ep10
programme.desc: The Mekong Delta is one of the largest on Earth. Formed over the last 8000 years, it fans out and discharges into the South China Sea via nine channels.

programme.title: Smashing Frank / 搗破法蘭克
programme.desc: Four young thieves wearing bunny masks pull off the heists targeting the rich. Calling themselves "Frank," their mission is less about money and more about exposing corruption through graffiti and viral videos. However, when they collide with a powerful church involved in a money-laundering scheme, their mission spirals into a deadly game.

programme.title: Detective Chinatown 1900 / 唐探1900
programme.desc: In 1900s San Francisco, a white woman is murdered in Chinatown, and a Chinese man becomes the prime suspect. The crime sparks public outcry to shut down the district. Amid growing unrest, two Chinese detectives, Qin Fu and Ah Gui, race against time to uncover the true killer before prejudice and danger consume their community.

programme.title: As It Burns / 白晝如焚
programme.desc: Detective Wei investigates the death of Yan Zhen in an explosion which seems more than an accident to him. Wei then finds out that Yan Zhen looks a lot like Yin, the girlfriend of Yan Zhen’s childhood friend Lu, and uncovers a tangled web of deceit leading to surprising revelations when he merges details from the past and the present.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate / 龍門飛甲
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperor’s eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News / OMG! 阿媽有喜
programme.desc: 53-year-old Rita and her husband are planning retirement when she discovers she's unexpectedly pregnant, upending their quiet family life. As they prepare for the baby amid chaos and laughter, they learn profound lessons in love and acceptance. Just as peace returns, Rita learns the fetus may have Down syndrome, confronting her with the ultimate crossroads

programme.title: Haunted Mountains: The Yellow Taboo / 山忌 黃衣小飛俠
programme.desc: A photographer and his friends venture into a remote mountain for a photo shoot, unaware they have entered a forbidden area. As eerie incidents unfold, a mysterious boy in a yellow raincoat who leaps through the forest appears, leading them to uncover an ancient curse and terrifying secrets hidden deep within the mountain.

programme.title: Customs Frontline / 海關戰線
programme.desc: The Hong Kong Customs officers uncover illegal weapons on a cargo ship linked to an international conflict. Elite agents go undercover and reveal a multinational operation with ties closer to home.

programme.title: Last Song For You / 久彆重逢
programme.desc: That summer, young Xia and Su bonded over their love of music, wondering how far this love could take them. Years later, musician Su unexpectedly reunites with his first love, Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journey—her parting gift to reignite his life.

programme.title: She’s Got No Name / 醬園弄·懸案
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks “Jiang Yuan Nong”. Frail woman Zhan Zhou Shi, driven to despair by years of domestic abuse, kills and dismembers her husband, then remains at the scene to surrender. The case seems clear-cut, yet remains riddled with doubt. As the truth unravels, a shocking reversal rewrites everyone’s fate.

programme.title: The Last Dance / 破·地獄
programme.desc: Amid the recession caused by the pandemic, debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. His unconventional approach leads to unexpected success, and his attitude toward his career and life is transformed after being inspired by the respected Master Wen.

programme.title: The Way We Are / 天水圍的日與夜
programme.desc: Set in Tin Shui Wai, a marginalised satellite town, Kwai is a middle-aged widow who works hard in a neighbourhood supermarket to support herself and her son. They lead a mundane but fulfilling life. When an elderly woman who lives alone moved in to Tin Shui Wai, Kwai strikes up a friendship with her and helps her ease into a new life.

programme.title: If You are the One III / 非誠勿擾III
programme.desc: Qin Fen retires alone to a small island in 2031 while his wife Xiao Xiao works abroad for the past 10 years. Qin Fen misses Xiao Xiao very much, so his friend makes an intelligent robot in Xiao Xiao’s image to keep Qin company. As they begin to live happily, Xiao Xiao suddenly returns, and Qin Fen must now choose between the two “Xiao Xiao”

programme.title: CJ7 / 長江七號
programme.desc: Stephen Chow returns in this hilarious and heartwarming tale of a father and son who discover an adorable alien in the trash.

programme.title: The Brotherhood of Rebel / 紮職 2
programme.desc: Chai, a triad member, helps his childhood friend Meow flee Hong Kong after discovering that Meow attempted to kill his triad boss. 17 years later, Chai becomes a key member of the triad. When he runs into Meow one day, he knows that his gang will kill Meow if they find him. Caught between triad and brotherhood, what will Chai choose?

programme.title: A Writer's Odyssey II / 刺殺小說家2
programme.desc: Fallen novelist Lu Kong Wen is drawn into the fantasy world of his own novel, where a powerful villain awakens with self-awareness and plots to invade reality. Forced to join forces with his fictional heroes, Lu becomes caught in a cross-dimensional battle that will determine the fate of both worlds.

programme.title: To the Fore / 破風
programme.desc: The cycling team’s top sprinter Zheng Zi Yuan teams up with two domestiques, Ming and Tian, who assist him to win the race. When Ming and Tian get tired of sacrificing their own chances to win, an accident causes the team to break up but the trio soon team up again for another race. Who will be the first to cross the line this time?

programme.title: The Vanished Murderer / 消失的兇手
programme.desc: Set in Northern China in 1932, inmate Fu Yuan escapes from prison by digging a tunnel with a silver spoon. Inspector Song Dong Lu is assigned to investigate the case. Following letters sent by Fu, Song travels to Hong City to uncover the mystery behind her disappearance, facing deeper conspiracies along the way.

programme.title: One More Chance / 別叫我"賭神"
programme.desc: A gambling-addicted Fai is entrusted by his ex-girlfriend to care for their autistic son. What begins as a chaotic father-son relationship gradually becomes a journey of mutual redemption, helping him rediscover himself. When he discovers his son’s talent for running, Fai resolves to leave the past behind and support his son in pursuing his dreams.

programme.title: Operation Mekong / 湄公河行動
programme.desc: After it is discovered that the drugs seized on the Chinese ships had been planted by the henchman of a notorious drug cartel leader named Naw Khar, the governments of Thailand, Laos, Myanmar and China launched a joint task force to apprehend the criminal by sending a band of elite narcotics officers to the Golden Triangle to uncover the truth.

programme.title: The Monkey King 2 / 西遊記之孫悟空三打白骨精
programme.desc: Monkey King is tasked with escorting Monk Tang on his journey to the West to retrieve the scriptures. During the trip, Monk Tang is being targeted by the seductive yet deadly White Bone Spirit, who feeds on the innocents to gain immortality. Monkey King will have to fight the White Bone Spirit in order to save Monk Tang!
